sa: अत्रेः पुत्रोऽभवत् सोमः सोमस्य तुबुधः स्मृतः। बुधस्यैको महेन्द्राभः पुत्र आसीत् पुरूरवाः॥
en: Atri had Soma for his son and Soma's son was called Buddha. Buddha's son was Pururava whose effulgence was like that of the great Indra.

sa: भार्गवास्त्रं च पश्यामि ज्वलन्तं कृष्ण सर्वशः। सृष्टं कर्णेन वार्ष्णेय शक्रेणेव यथाशनिम्॥
en: The sight of the Bhargava weapon, let loose by Karna and floating on the air like the great thunder of Shakra, meets also my view,

sa: विरथो भीमसेनेन कृतोऽसि बहुशो रणे। न च त्वां परुषं किंचिदुक्तवान् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: You were several times, in battle, deprived of your car by Bhimasena. But the son of Pandu did never utter any harsh words to you.

sa: श्रुतकीर्ति च नवभिः सुतसोमं च पञ्चभिः। अष्टभिः श्रुतकर्माणं प्रतिविध्यं त्रिभिः शरैः॥ शतानीकं च नवभिर्धर्मपुत्रं च पञ्चभिः। तथेतरांस्ततः : शूरान् द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यामताडयत्॥ श्रुतकीर्तेस्तथा चापं चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः।
en: And he struck Srutakirti with nine arrows and Sutasoma with five; and Prativindhya with three arrows and Srutakarma with eight. And he. struck Raja Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, with five arrows and Satanika with nine. And then he struck other warriors with two shafts each and cut into pieces the bow of Srutakirti with very sharp pointed arrows.

sa: च च्छिन्नो बहुधा राजन् सूतपुत्रेण धन्विना। निपपात शरस्तूर्णं निर्विषो भुजगो यथा॥
en: () king, that shaft of Dhristadyumna severed into numerous pieces, quickly fell down on the earth like, O sire, a snake without its poisonous fangs.

sa: तस्य तस्य शिरश्छित्त्वा ययुोणशराः क्षितिम्। एवं सा पाण्डवी सेना वध्यमाना महात्मना॥
en: Had their heads cut-off by Drona with arrows which (then) entered into the earth. The army of the Pandavas thus slaughtered by that high-souled one.

sa: भल्लाभ्यां भृशतीक्ष्णाभ्यां चिच्छेद धनुषी तयोः। ततो विराटः कुपितः समरे तोमरान् दश॥
en: Cut off the bows cf them both with a couple of broad headed shafts of great sharpness. Thereupon, filled with rage, Virata hurled ten tomaras.

sa: सर्वं तत्खलु मे मोघं यत्तप्तं परमं तपः। यत्समानो महेन्द्रेण मानुषेण विनिर्जितः॥
en: Forsooth all the austere asceticism I have performed go go for nothing, for although resembling the redoubtable Indra, I have been overcome by a mortal.

sa: एतया किल सङ्ग्रामे मायया राक्षसेश्वर। प्रयुक्तया गतिः शक्या नहि ज्ञातुं सुरासुरैः॥
en: O lord of Rākşasas, these illusory powers being used in a conflict, even the celestials and Asuras shall not be able to perceive his course.

sa: न ते संभाषितुं शक्याः संप्रश्नोऽत्र न विद्यते। प्रकृत्या कोपनास्तीक्ष्णा वानरा राक्षसाधिप॥
en: They are insuseptible of being spoken, to. No doubt whatever can exist that, o lord of Rāskhasas, the monkeys are by nature wrathful and fierce.

sa: तच्छूलं परमद्धो जग्राह युधि वीर्यवान्। अनीकैः समरे शूरै राक्षसैः परिवारितः॥ समुद्यम्य महाकायो ननाद युधि भैरवम्। संरक्तनयनो रोषात्स्वसैन्यमभिहर्षयन्॥ पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च दिशश्च प्रदिशस्तथा। प्राकम्पयत्तदा शब्दो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दारुणः॥
en: And fired with furious wrath, that powerful one took the dart in the encounter, surrounded in that contest by many heroic Rākşasas. And uplifting (the dart), the huge-bodied Ravana, with his eyes reddened in passion, emitted mighty roars. And the shouts ofd the Rākşasa sovereign made the earth and the sky and the cardinal quarters and all sides tremble.

sa: समर्था गगनं गन्तुमपि च त्वं रसातलम्। अवगच्छाद्य कर्तव्यं कर्तव्यं ते मदन्तरे॥
en: You are capable of even going to the nethermost regions. But do you on my behalf that which is fit to be done by you.

sa: एष शास्ता च गोप्ता च नेता च युधि सत्तमः। भूतिकामश्च मे नित्यं नित्यं च समरप्रियः॥
en: He is capable of chastising foes as well as of protecting his own and leading them; and he is excellent in warfare. And he is always desirous of my prosperity, and always love warfare.

sa: प्रहस्तवाक्यं त्वहितं निशम्य विभीषणे राजहितानुकानी। ततो महार्थं वचनं बभाषे धर्मार्थकामेषु निविष्टबुद्धिः॥
en: Hearing Prahasta's speech, Vibhisana, seeking the welfare of the king, and having his intellect grounded in virtue, interest and profit, said words enfolding high sense.

sa: प्रीतिस्फीताक्षौ संप्रहृष्टौ कुमारौ दृष्ट्वा सिद्धार्थों वानराणां च राजा। अङ्गैः प्रहृष्टैः कार्यसिद्धिं विदित्वा बाह्वोरासन्नामतिमात्रं ननन्द ॥
en: And beholding-these two princes greatly delighted and their eyes expanded with joy, the king of the monkeys, thought that the accomplishment of the great work was near at hand, and was accordingly greatly delighted."

sa: उद्यमः क्रियतां वीर हर्षः समुपसेव्यताम्। प्राप्तव्या यदि ते सीता हन्तव्याश्च निशाचराः॥
en: If you are to have Sītā, and if the nightrangers are to be slain by you, do you, Raghu's son, listen to my profitable speech.

sa: त्रिशङ्कुर्विमलो भाति राजर्षिः सपुरोहितः। पितामहः पुरोऽस्माकमिक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम्।।४९ विमले च प्रकाशेते विशाखे निरुपद्रवे। नक्षत्रं परमस्माकमिक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम्॥
en: And before us shine the grandfather of the high-souled Ikşavākus; the spotless Rājarși Trisaiku, with his priest.-And stainless and free from disturbances appear Visākhā. This is the racial star of us, the high-souled Ikșwākus.

sa: सैषा जनकराजस्य प्रसूता तनया प्रभो। तव भार्या महाबाहो विष्णुस्त्वं हि सनातनः॥
en: O Lord, this is she that has been born as the daughter of king Janaka, your wife, O mightyarmed one. You are the eternal Visnu.

sa: ते दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं वानराः पर्वतोपमम्। वायुनुन्न इव घना ययुः सर्वा दिशस्तदा॥
en: Seeing that foremost of Rākşasas resembling a hill, the monkeys began to disperse in all the ten cardinal directions like clouds driven by the wind.

sa: जाम्बवांश्च हनूमांश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः। ऋषभश्चैव कलशाञ्जलपूर्णानथानयन्॥ नदीशतानां पञ्चानां जलं कुम्भैरुपाहरन्।
en: Jambavan, Hanumān, the monkey Vegadarsi and Rşabha brought the jars filled with water and another monkeys brought the water in jars from five hundred rivers.

sa: तां गङ्गां पुनरासाद्य वसन्तं मुनिसंनिधौ। अविघ्नं पुष्ययोगेन श्वो रामं द्रष्टुमर्हसि ॥
en: Again reaching the Ganges he is living with the ascetic; it become you to behold him tomorrow under the auspices of Pushya, without any hindrance.

sa: बद्धं कालस्य पाशेन सर्वभूतापहारिणः। न नश्यन्तमुपेक्षे त्वां प्रदीप्तं शरणं यथा ॥
en: How can I disregard your death like to a burning house bound as you are by the noose of Death, the destroyer of all creatures.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणामिततेजसा॥ वानराधिपतिः श्रीमांस्तैश्च सर्वैः समावृतः। प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं शीघ्रं तारामुद्वीक्ष्य सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, of unmitigated prowess-the beautiful lord of monkeys, encircled by them, entered speedily the inner apartment and beholding lārā there, said.

sa: ते रक्तकण्ठिनः सर्वे किंनरा इव शिक्षिताः। तुष्टुवुर्नृपतिं वीरं यथा वत्सं प्रहर्षिणः॥
en: And those songsters, well trained and having a musical voice like the Kinnaras, began to eulogise the heroic king, to the increase of his joy.

sa: लक्ष्यालक्ष्येण रूपेण रात्रौ लङ्कापुरी मया। प्राप्तकालं प्रवेष्टुं मे कृत्यं साधयितुं महत्॥
en: For attaining this mighty object, it behove me to enter Lankā at night in a shape invisible yet well suited to the end in view.

sa: गते हि त्वयि विक्रान्ते पुनरागमनाय वै। प्राणानामपि संदेहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः॥
en: O you gifted with great prowess, yourself departing, I shall wait for your return, but doubt I very much whether I shall live till then.

sa: न शक्यं मामवज्ञाय प्रवेष्टुं नगरीमिमाम्। अद्य प्राणैः परित्यक्तः स्वप्स्यसे निहतो मया॥
en: You are unable to enter this city, passing me by. You shall to-day, losing your life and slain by me, sleep (the sleep of death).

sa: सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च त्वं गृहीत्वा स्वां गतिं गतः। आत्मानमनुशोचामि त्वद्विनाशेन दुःखिताम्॥
en: Carrying your pious and iniquitous deeds you have attained to your own state-I am only lamenting for me who have been sorry for your destruction.

sa: मम प्रतिप्रदानं हि रावणस्य न रोचते। रावणं मार्गते संख्ये मृत्युः कालवशंगतम्॥
en: Rāvana dose not desire to restore me (to Rāma) for he has been brought under the influence of Death who is seeking him in battle.

sa: शूरेण धनदभ्रात्रा बलैः समुदितेन च। अपोह्य रामं कस्माच्चिद् दारचौर्यं त्वया कृतम्॥
en: You are heroic and Kubera's brother and great in prowess, why didst you then take me by stealth after despatching Rāma away from the hermitage?”

sa: ततस्तस्य गिरिर्मूर्ध्नि वयं प्रायमुपास्महे। दृष्ट्वा प्रायोपविष्टांश्च सर्वान्वानरपुङ्गवान्॥ भृशं शोकार्णवे मग्नः पर्यदेवयदङ्गदः।
en: And on the crest of that hill we took to fasting. And beholding those foremost of monkeys engaged in fasting Angada, sunk in grief, bewailed,

sa: रामं च लक्ष्मणं चैव घोरैनागमयैः शरैः॥ बिभेद समरे क्रुद्धः सर्वगात्रेषु राघवौ।
en: And worked up into rage, he in the conflict pierced Raghu's sons, Rāma and Lakşmaņa all over their bodies, with terrific arrows consisting of serpents.

sa: तं ब्रुवाणं तु तद्वाक्यं राजर्षि धार्मिकं तदा। जिघृक्षुरब्रवीत्कन्यां बाढमित्येव स द्विजः॥
en: When that virtuous (sage) had said this, the twice-born Räjarși, desirous of accepting the girl (after due nuptial rights), said to the former, 'Well !'

sa: दशयोजनसाहस्रं तदेव परिगण्यते। तत्र संनिहिता मेघास्त्रिविधा नित्यशः स्थिता:॥ आग्नेयाः पक्षिणो ब्राह्मास्त्रिविधास्तत्र ते स्थिताः। अथ गत्वा तृतीयं तु वायो पन्थानमुत्तमम्॥ नित्यं यत्र स्थिताः सिद्धाश्चारणाश्च मनस्विनः। दशैव तु सहस्राणि योजनानां तथैव च॥ चतुर्थं वायुमार्गं तु शीघ्रं गत्वा परंतप। असन्ति यत्र नित्यस्था भूताश्च सविनायकाः॥
en: The extent thereof is also counted by ten thousand leagues and there are stationed closely three classes of clouds* namely Āgneya, Paksaja and Brahma. He then proceeded to the third excellent aerial region where perpetually reside the high-minded Siddhas and Cāraṇas and the extent whereof is also ten thousand leagues. O slayer of enemies, he then speedily proceeded to the fourth aerial region where perpetually dwell the goblins and Vinayakas. *The three classes are (1) Agnija or produced from fire (2) Pakşaja or produced in a fortnight (3) Brāhma or produced from Brāhma.

sa: इत्येवमर्थं कपिरन्ववेक्ष्य सीतेयमित्येव तु जातबुद्धिः। संश्रित्य तस्मिन् निषसाद वृक्षे बली हरीणामृषभस्तरस्वी॥
en: Having reflected thus and arrived at ine conclusion that she was Sītā, that powerful leader of monkeys gifted with velocity stationed himself on that tree.

sa: व्याघ्रो वराहो जीमूतः पर्वतः सागरो दुमः। यक्षो दैत्यस्वरूपी च सोऽदृश्यत दशाननः॥
en: The Ten-necked Ravana (successively) assumed the shapes of a tiger, a boar, a cloud, a hill, the ocean, a tree, a Yaksa and a Daitya.

sa: स तु सर्वं समयँव मन्त्रिभिः कृत्यमात्मनः। सभां प्रविश्य विदधे विदित्वा रामविक्रमम्॥
en: Having decided his entire course of action in consultation with his competent advisers, (Ravana), entering his court, well knowing Rāma's prowess, set about his work.

sa: ततः खङ्गेन महता हत्वा तामिन्द्रजित्स्वयम्। हृष्टः स रथमास्थाय ननाद च महास्वनम्॥
en: a Destroying her with his own hand by means of a huge sword, Indrajit, greatly pleased ascended his car and began to emit dreadful roars.

sa: अकाले चापि पुष्पाणि मूलानि च फलानि च। नद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र तिष्ठेयुर्यत्र वानराः॥
en: Let there be flowers, fruits and roots, even out of season wherever these monkeys shall live and let rivers there be full of clear water.

sa: तासां मध्यात् समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत्। आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीतामसितेक्षमाम्॥ जनकस्यात्मजां साध्वीं स्नुषां दशरथस्य च।
en: Then sitting up in their midst, Trijatā spoke, “Do you without delay fall to your own selves; but never (eat up) the dark-eyed Sītā, the chaste daughter to Janaka and the daughter-in-law of Dasaratha."

sa: कस्य चिन हि दुर्बुद्धेश्छन्दतो जायते मतिः। यादृशं कुरुते कर्म तादृशं फलमश्नुते॥
en: The mind of a perverse man does not willingly incline towards good; and as he acts, he gets the fruits (he reaps as he sows).

sa: तदैव रामः प्लवगाधिपस्तथा विभीषणश्चर्क्षपतिश्च वीर्यवान्। अवेक्ष्य सौमित्रिमरोगमुत्थितं मुदा ससैन्याः सुचिरं जहषिरे॥
en: Rāma and the monkey-king and Vibhīşaņa! and the powerful lord of bears along with their hosts, seeing Sumitrā's son risen hale, rejoiced greatly in delight.

sa: विद्युज्जिह्वस्तदागृह्य शिरस्तत्सशरासनम्। प्रणाम शिरसा कृत्वा रावणस्याग्रतः स्थितः॥ तमब्रवीत्ततो राजा रावणो राक्षसं स्थितम्। विद्युज्जिह्व महाजिद समीपपरिवर्तिनम्॥
en: Thereat, Vidyujjibha, taking the head along with the bow, bowing down the head (to Ravana), stood before him. Then spoke king Rävaņa to the Rākşasa, Vidyujjibha of the long tongue, who was staying by.

sa: एवं दत्त्वा वरांस्तेभ्यस्तस्मिन्यज्ञोत्सवे सुराः। निवृत्ते सह राज्ञा ते पुनः स्वभवनं गताः॥
en: Having thus conferred boons on them at that festal place, the celestials, along with the king, (on the sacrifice) having ended, went to their abode.

sa: अहल्यया त्वेवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच स गौतमः। उत्पत्स्यति महातेजा इक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः॥ रामो नाम श्रुतो लोके वनं चाप्युपयास्यति। ब्राह्मणार्थे महाबाहुर्विष्णुर्मानुषविग्रहः।॥ तं द्रक्ष्यसि यदा भद्रे ततः पूता भविष्यसि। स हि पावयितुं शक्तस्त्वया यदुष्कृतं कृतम्॥
en: Ahalyā having said this, Gautama replied:In the race of Ikşvākus, there shall be born a highly effulgent and mighty car-warrior, known in the world as Răma; for performing the rites of a Brahmana, the mighty-armed Visnu, assuming a human form, shall repair to the forest. You shall be purified when you shall behold him, O fair damsel. He shall be able to purify you from the iniquity perpetrated.

sa: अथ वा त्यक्तशस्त्रस्य मृगतस्तरसा रिपून्॥ न मे प्रतिमुखः कश्चित्स्थातुं शक्तो जिजीविषुः।
en: And who wishing to save himself shall be able to stay before me as I casting away my weapons keep pounding my enemies with celerity?

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणामिततेजसा॥ वानराधिपतिः श्रीमांस्तैश्च सर्वैः समावृतः। प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं शीघ्रं तारामुद्वीक्ष्य सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, of unmitigated prowess-the beautiful lord of monkeys, encircled by them, entered speedily the inner apartment and beholding lārā there, said.

sa: व्यपेतदोषमस्यन्तौ लघु चित्रं च सुष्ठु च। उभौ तु तुमुलं घोरं चक्रतुर्नरराक्षसौ॥
en: The skill that they displayed was perfect, and showed lightness, variety and grace; and both man and the Rākşasa carried on fearful and terrible conflict.

sa: न तु क्षमं वीर्यवता तेन धर्मानुवर्तिना। वैरं निरर्थकं कर्तुं दीयतामस्य मैथिली॥
en: And (Rama), possessed of prowess, yet ever abiding by morality, is incapable of initiating hostilities for no purpose. Therefore, do you give him his Maithili.

sa: अद्य पश्य महाबाहो मया समरमूर्धनि। हते रामे सह भ्रात्रा द्रवन्तीं हरिवाहिनीम्॥
en: O long-armed one, behold, on Rāma having been slain by me on the edge of battle along with his brother, the monkey-army in headlong flight.

sa: सख्यं च रामः सुग्रीवे प्रभावं चानिलात्मजे। वानराणां च तत्कर्म ह्याचचक्षेऽथ मन्त्रिणाम्॥
en: Thereupon before the ministers Rāma began to describe the friendship of Sugrīva, the prowess of the Wind-gods son and the works accomplished by the monkeys.

sa: यथा चारोपितो वृक्षो जातश्चान्तनिवेशने। महानपि दुरारोहो महास्कन्धः प्रशाखवान्॥ शीर्येत पुष्पितो भूत्वा न फलानि प्रदर्शयन्। तस्य नानुभवेदर्थं यस्य हेतोः स रोपितः॥ एषोपमा महाबाहो त्वमर्थं वेत्तुमर्हसि। यद्यस्मान्मनुजेन्द्र त्वं भर्ता भृत्यान्न शाधि हि॥
en: If a tree, planted in the inner apartment of a house, growing huge with a big trunk and many branches, is dried up as soon it blossoms without bearing fruits, his object for whom it is planted, becomes fruitless? And this simili, O you of long arms, shall prove good in you, if did you not, our master, govern us, O lord of men, who are your servants.

sa: ततः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं वैदूर्यजतोक्षितम्। मर्यादां प्रतिहाराणां तोरणान्तरमाविशत्॥ तं तु राजन्दशग्रीवं प्रविशन्तं निशाचरम्। सूर्यभानुरिति ख्यातो द्वारपालो न्यवारयत्॥
en: Then (Rāvana) entered within the gate-way (of the place), garnished with gold, and decked with lapises and silver, And thereat, o king, the warder named Sūryabhānu prevented the nightranger Daśagrīva as he was entering.

sa: दृष्ट्वा पतन्तं तं वृक्षमसंभ्रान्तश्च राक्षसः। चिच्छेद बहुधा सोऽपि मथितः प्रापतद्भुवि ॥
en: Seeing the tree in full career, the Räksasa without betraying any agitation, severed it in pieces; and the tree, thus assailed, fell to the earth.

sa: अकृत्वा कत्थसे कर्म किमर्थमिह राक्षस। कुरु तत्कर्म येनाहं श्रद्धेयं तव कत्थनम्॥
en: Why, O Raksasa, without doing (what you say), did you simply say it? Do the deed, so that I may have regard for your utterances.

sa: यथा दृप्तश्च मातङ्गः शशश्च सहितौ वने। तथा द्विरदवद् रामस्त्वं नीच शशवत्स्मृतः॥
en: Like to an infuriated elephant encountering a hare in the forest, you shall O Vile! a hare as you are, meet with that elephant-like Rāma.

sa: ऋद्धिं ममानुपश्य त्वं श्रियं भद्रे यशस्विनि। किं करिष्यसि रामेण सुभगे चीरवासिना॥
en: Ogently lady, O you of great renown, do you observe my prosperity. What shall you do with Răma, wearing bark, O you of pleasant presence.

sa: भिद्यमानाः शरैः संख्ये नारायणकरच्युतैः। निपेतू राक्षसा भूमौ शैला वज्रहता इव ॥
en: In that conflict, pierced by the arrows discharged from Nārāyana's arm, the Rākşasa began to drop to the ground like mountains struck with the thunder-bolt.

sa: एवं तव हतो भर्ता ससैन्यो मम सेनया। क्षतजा, रजोध्वस्तमिदं चास्याहृतं शिरः॥
en: Thus has your lord been slain by my forces, along with his army; and I have his head, washed in blood and besmeared with dust.

sa: साहं बन्धुजनैींना हीना नाथेन च त्वया॥ विहीना कामभोगैश्च शोचिष्ये शाश्वतीः समाः।
en: Deprived of my friends and relatives, separated from you O my lord, deprived from the enjoyment of many pleasures I shall lament for you perpetually.

sa: ऐश्वर्ये वा सुविस्तीर्णे व्यसने वा सुदारुणे। रज्ज्वेव पुरुषं बद्ध्वा कृतान्तः परिकर्षति॥
en: Whether in the enjoyment of vast riches, or emerged in the abyss of miseries, Death is pulling a man, binding him roughly with a chord.

sa: राक्षसैरभिभूताः स्मो न शक्ताः स्म प्रजापते। स्वेषु सद्मसु संस्थातुं भयात्तेषां दुरात्मनाम्॥
en: We have been overpowered by the Rākṣasas. And, o lord of creatures, from fear of those wicked-minded ones, we cannot remain in our own homes.

sa: कृत्वा केचिद् वदन्त्यन्ये केचिद् बुध्यन्ति चेतरत्। येऽप्यत्र मधुपालाः स्युः प्रेष्या दधिमुखस्य तु॥ तेऽपि तैर्वानीमैः प्रतिषिद्धा दिशो गताः। जानुभिश्च प्रघृष्टाश्च देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः॥
en: Some spoke contrary to what they had doneand others put a different construction thereon. And all the waiters of the garden and the servants of Dadhimukha, were repressed by those terrible monkeys with censure and thrown up in the shy by their Knee-joints. And terrified, they fled to different directions.

sa: प्राणैरपि प्रियं कार्यं देवानां हि सदा मया। सोऽहं वो निहनिष्यामि रसातलगतानपि॥
en: I should always lay down my life for serving the celestials and you I will slay even if you should go to the nethermost regions.

sa: इत्यहं तस्य शापस्य भीतः प्रसभमेव ताम्। नारोहये बलात्सीतां वैदेहीं शयने शुभे॥
en: It is for this, that with my mind afflicted with fear, I do not violently force, Videha's daughter Sītā, anent lying with her fair self.

sa: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धि लभते नरः। स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धि यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु।॥
en: Every man, if he engages in his own natural duty, attains to perfection. Hear, how man attains to perfection by performing him own natural duties,

sa: तथापि निकृतिप्रज्ञं पुत्रं दुर्दूतदेविनम्। न शक्नोमि नियन्तुं वा कर्तुं वा हितमात्मनः॥
en: Can not yet retain my son who considers folly to be wisdom and who is addicted to gambling, and cannot thus effect my own good.

sa: यदि तावत्समुद्रे तु सेतुर्बद्धो यदृच्छया। रामेण विस्मयः कोऽत्र येन ते भयमागतम्॥
en: If Rāma bath at his pleasure constructed a bridge over the ocean, what is the wonder in this that you have conceived such a fear?

sa: यो नैतेभ्यः प्रच्यवेद् द्वादशभ्यः सर्वामपीमां पृथिवीं स शिष्यात्। त्रिभिभ्यिामेकतो वाऽर्थितो यो नास्य स्वमस्तीति च वेदितव्यम्॥
en: He, who does not deviate from these twelve, can rule even the whole of this earth. He who is graced with these two or even one, does not regard anything as solely his own.

sa: एवं मे निश्चिता बुद्धिर्हदि मारीच विद्यते। न व्यावर्तयितुं शक्या सेन्ट्रैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: I have made this firm resolution in my mind O, Marica; even Indra, with the celestials and Asuras shall not be able to shake it.

sa: अश्वत्थामा महाभागः कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥ कृपः शारद्वतश्चैव वक्तव्या वचनान्मम। अधर्मेण प्रवृत्तानां पाण्डवानामनेकशः॥ विश्वासं समयघ्नानां न यूयं गन्तुमर्हथ। वार्तिकांश्चाब्रवीद् राजा पुत्रस्ते सत्यविक्रमः॥ अधर्माद् भीमसेनेन निहतोऽहं यथा रणे।
en: The highly blessed Ashvatthaman, and Kritavarman, of the Satwata race, and Sharadvat's son Kripa, should be told these words of mine, viz.-. You should never place any confidence upon the Pandavas, those violators of rules who have committed many unrighteous acts. After this, your royal and bearers in these words:-I have, in battle, been killed by Bhimasena most unfairly.

sa: तवाशिषः प्रयुञ्जानो भविष्यामि वनेचरः॥ उचितं नः कुले तात सर्वेषां भरतर्षभ। पुत्रेष्वैश्वर्यमाधाय वयसोऽन्ते वनं नृप॥ तत्राहं वायुभक्षो वा निराहारोऽपि वा वसन्। पल्या सहानया वीर चरिष्यामि तपः परम्॥
en: I shall live in the forest, always blessing you. It is proper, O son, for the members of our family, to make over sovereignty, when old age comes, to children and lead the forest mode of life. Living there on air alone, or abstaining froin all food, I shall, with this wife of mine, O hero, practice severe austeities.

sa: धर्मे चानवरौ राजन् सत्यतायां च भारत। रामाद् दाशरथेश्चैव गयाच्चैव न संशयः॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata, O king they are not certainly inferior to Rama, the son of Dasharatha and Gaya in the virtue and truthfulness.

sa: स चकार तदात्मानं विशल्यं सहसा विभुः। जग्राह च शरं तीक्ष्णमस्त्रेणापि समाददे।८।।
en: Then that lord at once extricated the arrow; and then took up a keen shaft and fixed the same on his weapon.* *i.e. the bow.

sa: समयं हतः। एकादशचमूभर्ता सोऽहमेतां दशां गतः॥ कालं प्राप्य महाबाहो न कश्चिदतिवर्तते।
en: I was the master of eleven Chamus of troops and yet I have come by this plight. O mighty-armed one, no one can control Destiny.

sa: योऽयं विमर्देष्वविभग्नपूर्वः सुरैः समस्तैरपि वासवेन। भवन्तमासाद्य रणे विभग्नो वेलामिवासाद्य यथा समुद्रः॥
en: You have, like ine ocean breaking down its banks, broken him down, who had not been are this even defeated by Basava and the celestials.

sa: तस्य क्रुद्धो महाराज वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः॥ सृजस्व शवरान् घोरानिति स्वां गामुवाच ह।
en: That best of Rishis, viz., Vashishtha O king, became angry with Vishvamitra. He commanded his own sacrificial cow, saying "Create a number of terrible Shavaras.

sa: हृष्टः कथय विस्रब्धो यावदारोप्यते धनुः। सृष्टश्च हि मया बाणो निरस्तश्च रिपुस्तव॥
en: Do you cheerfully and confidingly speak while I fix the string to my bow. As soon as my shaft is off, your foe is beaten.

sa: नाध्यापनाद् याजनाद् वा अन्यस्माद् वा प्रतिग्रहात्। दोषो भवति विप्राणां ज्वलिताग्निसमा द्विजाः॥
en: They incur no fault in consequence of teaching, of officiating at sacrifice and of accepting gifts from others. The Brahmanas are like the blazing fire.

sa: तं निवृत्तं तु शुश्चाव चारणैव युधिष्ठिरः। श्रुत्वार्जुनं कुशलिनं स च हृष्टमनाऽभवत्॥
en: Yudhishthira heard from his intelligencebearers that the horse had turned back. And hearing also that Arjuna was hale and hearty, he became filled with joy.

sa: न चापि तृप्ति: कामानां विद्यतेऽद्यापि कस्यचित्।।७४। तस्मात् परिग्रहे भूमेर्यतन्ते कुरुपाण्डवाः। साम्ना भेदेन दानेन दण्डेनैव च भारत॥ पिता भ्राता च पुत्राश्च खं द्योश्च नरपुङ्गव। भूमिर्भवति भूतानां सम्यगच्छिद्रदर्शना॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, their ambition is unlimited; it is for this the Kurus and the Pandavas are trying, to get possession of the earth by negotiations, by disunion, by gift and by battle. O foremost of men, if earth be properly treated, she becomes the father, the mother, the children, the sky and the heaven of all creatures.

sa: सर्वथा त्वपनीतं ते सीतया यत् प्रचोदितः। क्रोधस्य वशमागम्य नाकरोः शासनं मम॥.
en: You have every way done wrong in not acting out my mandate in consequence of being urged by Sītā, and under the influence of indignation.

sa: सर्वे भवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तु सर्वे पश्यन्तु मां युधि। निवारयन्तं संग्रामे बलात् सौभं सराजकम्॥
en: "(O warriors), do not lose courage; stay and see me fight. I shall repel with force (the car) Saubha with the king (Shalva) on it.

sa: कपिलायाः प्रदानात् तु मुच्यते नात्र संशयः। तस्मादलंकृतां दद्यात् कपिलां तु द्विजातये॥
en: A man certainly rescues himself (from hell) by giving away Kapila cow, therefore a Kapila cow, decked with ornaments, should be given to a Brahmana.

sa: अस्मिंस्तृप्ते च तृप्यन्ते पितरो दैवतानि च। न हि श्रुतवतां किंचिदधिकं ब्राह्मणादृते॥
en: If the Brahmana be pleased, the departed Manes and the deities also are pleased. There is nothing superior to a Brahmana possessed of Vedic learning.

sa: अवमानेन युक्तस्य स्थानभ्रष्टस्य वा पुनः कथं यास्यसि विश्वासमहं तिष्ठामि वा कथम्॥
en: I have been insulted by you and degraded from my place. How will you trust me again? How shall I continue to live with you?

sa: परिष्वजिष्ये राजानं धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम्। एतावदुक्त्वा भीमं तु विसृज्य च महायशाः॥ सम्प्रेक्षत् तावकं सैन्यं व्याघ्रो मृगगणानिव।
en: I shall embrace the illustrious king viz., Yudhishthira.” Having thus spoken to Bhima, the high-famed Satyaki left him. He then cast his eyes on your troops like a tiger looking at herds of deer.

sa: संजय उवाच अनुज्ञातस्ततो राज्ञा परिष्वक्तश्च फाल्गुनः। प्रेम्णा दृष्टश्च बहुधा ह्याशिषश्चास्य योजिताः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then king Yudhishthira gave Phalguna the permission he sought; and embraced him and cast affectionate glances him and pronounced numerous benedictions on him.

sa: देवपुत्रसमाः सर्वे शौर्ये शक्रसमा युधि। ऋद्ध्या वैश्रवणं चाति नयेन च बृहस्पतिम्॥
en: All resembling sons of the gods and equal to Shakra in prowess in battle, prosperous as Vaishravana himself and wise in polity as Brihaspati himself.

sa: मन्यते पापकं कृत्वा न कश्चिद् वेत्ति मामिति। विदन्ति चैनं देवाश्च यश्चैवान्तरपूरुषः॥
en: Man, when sinning, thinks that no one sees him. But he is seen by the celestials and by the Deity who dwells in every heart.

sa: शक्यं खलु भवेद् राम सहायेन त्वयानघ। सुरराज्यमपि प्राप्तुं स्वराज्यं किमुत प्रभो॥
en: By your help, O Rama, one can, O sinless one, obtain the kingdom of the celestials,-what is to be said of one's kingdom, O lord?

sa: हुत्वा शतसहस्रं स सावित्र्या राजसत्तमः। षष्ठे षष्ठे तदा काले बभूव मितभोजनः॥
en: That most exalted of kings (daily) offered ten thousand oblations to Savitri and partook of a moderate food at the sixth portion of the day.

sa: स्यन्देते हि दिवा रुक्मं रात्रौ च द्विजसत्तम। नक्तं नक्षत्रताराणां प्रभामाक्षिप्य वर्ततः॥
en: O best of twice-born ones, these ear-rings, day and night, always produce gold. At night, they shine brightly, attracting the rays of stars and constellations.

sa: न गोष्ठ्या नोपकारेण न सम्बन्धनिमित्ततः। नानाहूतं नाप्यभृतं मम सैन्यं बभूव ह॥
en: And no for the sake of family relationship, nor from favour, nor from kinship. They have not come uncalled for, nor are they unpaid soldicrs.

sa: प्राप्ते काले तु सुषुवे कन्यां राजीवलोचनाम्। क्रियाश्च तस्या मुदितश्चक्रे च नृपसत्तमः॥
en: And at the proper time she gave birth to a daughter with eyes resembling lotus. And that best of kings gladly performed her natal rites.

sa: जित्वा लङ्कां सरक्षौघां हत्वा तं रावणं रणे। सीतामादाय गच्छामः सिद्धार्था हृष्टमानसाः॥
en: And therefore winning Larkā, slaying Rāvaņa along with his Rākşasa host in conflict and taking Sītā, let us go, delighted and having our ends accomplished.

sa: सर्वशस्त्रातिगौ सेनां प्रविष्टौ रथितसत्तमौ। दृष्ट्वा कां वै धृति युद्धे प्रत्यपद्यन्त मामकाः॥
en: Beholding those two foremost of carwarriors, both beyond the reach of all weapons, thus penetrate into my host, what resolution did my troops then form

sa: सा दुर्मुखस्य विमलं वर्म भित्त्वा यशस्विनः। विदार्य प्राविशद् भूमिं दीप्यमाना स्वतेजसा॥
en: That very resplendent dart charge with great energy penetrating through the massive armour of the renowned Durmukha, and shattering it, stuck itself on the ground.

sa: तथा हिधर्मसंयुक्तं बहु चित्रं च भाषसे। न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचिदिति त्वां लक्षयाम्यहम्॥
en: As you speak many and various words of virtue, I do not see there is anything in respect with it which you do not know.

sa: स्पृशतु त्वां समाश्लिष्य पुत्रोऽयं प्रियदर्शनः। पुत्रस्पर्शात् सुखतरः स्पर्शो लोके न विद्यते॥
en: Let this handsome son touch you in your embrace. There is nothing in the world more pleasing to the touch than that of a son.

sa: वृषो हि भगवान् धर्मो यस्तस्य कुरुते ह्यलम्। वृषं तं विदुर्देवास्तस्माद्धर्मं विवर्धयेत्॥
en: Righteousness has another name, viz., Vrisha. He who weakens Vrisha passes by the name of Vrishala. A king should, therefore, further the cause of Righteousness.

sa: कश्मलाभिहतो राजा चिन्तयामास पाण्डवः। न नूनं स्वस्ति पार्थाय यथा नदति शङ्खराट्॥
en: Then the royal of Pandu (Yudhishthira); overwhelmed with great anxiety, began to reflect thus-"Surely everything is not well with Arjuna, as this conch-blast indicates. son

sa: स कुम्भकर्णस्य भुजो निकृत्तः पपात भूमौ गिरिसंनिकाशः। विचेष्टमानो निजदान व्रुक्षान्शैलाशिलावानरराक्षसांश्च ॥
en: That arm of Kumbhakarma, being severed, dropped inert on the earth, like a hill, and crushed trees and rocks and crags and monkeys and Raksasas.

sa: धर्मराजः पितृव्यस्ते प्रीतिकामो दृढव्रतः। शुचिः सत्यप्रतिज्ञश्च स त्वां जातु न नाशयेत्॥
en: A righteous sovereign, steady in vow, clean, and truthful in promise, your uncle, who cherishes affection for you shall not by any mears chastise. Ju.

sa: न निःसृतं भवत्योष्ठाद्वचनं यावदर्थिनाम्॥ तावद्वानररक्षोभिर्दत्तमेवाभ्यदृश्यत। न कश्चिन्मलिनो वापि दीनो वाप्यथवा कृशः॥ तस्मिन्यज्ञवरे राज्ञो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते। ये च तत्र महात्मानो मुनयश्चिरजीविनः॥ नास्मरंस्तादृशं यज्ञं दानौघसमलंकृतम्।
en: Indeed before words came out from the lips of the beggars, monkeys and Rakşasas satisfied them with gifts. And all the ascetics living for ever and having asceticism for wealth that were present there, could not think of any other sacrifice, accompanied by so profuse presents, they had seen before.

sa: ध्रुवं पश्यति रूपाणि दीपाद् दीपशतं यथा। स वै विष्णुश्च वरुणोऽग्निः प्रजापतिः॥
en: Forsooth, he can perceive numerous bodies like a hundred lights from one light. Indeed, he is Vishnu and Mitra, and Varuna and Agni, and Prajapati.

sa: गन्धानादाय भूतानां रसांश्च विविधानपि। अवर्धं त्रीन् समाक्रम्य लोकान् वै स्वेन तेजसा॥
en: Appropriating various scents and various sorts of tastes that other creatures had for enjoying, I swelled up with my own energy, assailing the three worlds.

sa: वैशंपायन उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौन्तेया ब्राह्मणात् संशितव्रतात्। सर्वे चास्वस्थमनसो बभूवुस्ते महाबलाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard this, son of Kunti appeared as if they were pieced with darts. Those mighty men lost their peace of mind.

sa: तमुत्तमौजा जनमेजयश्च क्रुद्धौ युधामन्युशिखण्डिनौ च। कण बिभिदुः सहिताः पृषत्कैः संनर्दमानाः सह
en: Then Uttamaujas, Janamejaya, the wrathful Yudhamanyu, Shikhandin and Prishatha's son Dhristadumnya all in a body fiercely attacked Karna with many weapons and with loud roars.

sa: ततस्तमादाय तदा स मेने हरीन्द्रमिन्द्रोपममिन्द्रवीर्यः। अस्मिहन्ते सर्वमिदं हतं स्यात् सराघवं सैन्यमितीन्द्रशत्रुः॥
en: Thus taking him captive, that mighty one resembling Indra in puissance, thought his death would destroy the entire host of the opponents together with Rāghava.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अथ चेत् सर्वतः क्षत्रं प्रदुष्येद् ब्राह्मणं प्रति। कस्तस्य ब्राह्मणस्त्राता को धर्मः किं परायणम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said “If all the Kshatriyas stand against the Brahmanas, who then will protect the Brahmanas and their Vedas? What then should be the duty of the Brahmanas and who will be their shelter?"

sa: मृग उवाच न रिपून् वै समुद्दिश्य विमुञ्चन्ति नराः शरान्। रन्ध्र एषां विशेषेण वधः काले प्रशस्यते॥
en: The deer said : Man do not throw their arrows even at their enemies when they are unprepared. There is a time for doing it; to kill at such a time is not censurable.

sa: भीष्म उवाच आविश्यमाने दैत्ये तु ज्वरेणाथ महासुरे। देवतानामृषीणां च हर्षान्नादो महानभूत्॥
en: Bhishma said. When the great Asura or Daitya was possessed by that fever, the gods and the Rishis, filled with joy, sent up loud cheers.

sa: मैत्राः क्रूराणि कुर्वन्तो जयन्ति स्वर्गमुत्तमम्। धाः पापानि कुर्वाणा गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम्॥
en: The friends of humanity, by performing even acts of cruelty, have attained to exalted heaven. Pious Kshatriyas, by doing even sinful acts, to blessed ends.

sa: यथा दारुमयो हस्ती यथा चर्ममयो मृगः। यथा ह्यनथः षण्ढो वा पार्थ क्षेत्रं यथोषरम्॥ एवं विप्रोऽनधीयानो राजा यश्च न रक्षिता। मेघो न वर्षते यश्च सर्वथा ते निरर्थकाः॥
en: As an elephant made of wood, or a deer made of leather, as a person without riches, or one that is a eunuch, or a field which is barren, even so is a Brahmana who is void of Vedic learning and a king incapable of giving protection. Both of them are like a cloud that does not pour rain.

sa: अतीतमाज्ञाय तु पार्थिवर्षभं यशस्विनं तं परिवार्य पत्नयः। भृशं रुदत्यः करुणं सुदुः :खिताः प्रगृह्य बाहू व्यलपन्ननाथवत्॥
en: Knowing that the lord of earth had departed, his wives surrounding that illustrious one, smitten with excess of sorrow and weeping bitterly and piteously, holding the king's hands indulged in lamentations, like forlorn ones.

sa: अष्टक उवाच कतिस्विदेव मुनयः कति मौनानि चाप्युत। भवन्तीति तदाचक्ष्व श्रोतुच्छिामहे वयम्॥
en: Ashtaka said : How many kinds of Munis are there and how many kinds of Munis (observers of vows)? We desire to hear all this.

sa: भ्रातृणां देहि पञ्चानां पञ्च ग्रामान् सुयोधन। शान्ति!ऽस्तु महाप्राज्ञ ज्ञातिभिः सह संजया॥
en: O Suyodhana, give but five villages to your five cousins and let there be peace among ourselves and our cousins, O Sanjaya of great wisdom.

sa: सर्वधर्मान् परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रजा अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
en: Forsaking all religious duties, come to Me, come to Me as your sole refuge. I shall deliver yo:l from all your sins. Do not grieve.

sa: पयस्विनीस्तथा धेनूर्यानानि शयनानि च। ययौ राजंस्ततो रामो बकस्याश्रममन्तिकात्। यत्र तेपे तपस्तीव्र दाल्भ्यो बक इति श्रुतिः॥
en: Then, O king, Rama proceeded to the hermitage of Vaka which was not very far from where he was, the hermitage in which, as heard by us, Dalvya-vaka had practised the hardest of penances.”

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच रोरूयमाणस्याभ्याशे भृशं विप्रस्य पाण्डवः। तानि वाक्यानि शुश्राव कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus were the Pandavas reproved by the Brahmana weeping in bitter grief. The son of Kunti, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) heard his (weeping) words.

sa: यच्च कोपितयात्यर्थं त्वयोक्तोऽस्म्यप्रियं प्रिये। प्रणयिन्या विशालाक्षि तत् क्षान्तं ते मया शुभे॥
en: "O dearest, O lady of beautiful eyes, I have forgiven you for all the hard words you have uttered in anger. You are my darling.”

sa: एतत् संचिन्त्य राजेन्द्र यत् क्षेमं तत् समाचर। अप्रमत्तोत्थितो नित्यं चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षणे॥
en: O king of kings, reflecting on all this, do what is beneficial to you. Be always watchful in protecting the four orders (of your subjects).

sa: विहव्यस्य तु पुत्रस्तु वितत्यस्तस्य चात्मजः। वितत्यस्य सुतः सत्यः संतः सत्यस्य चात्मजः॥
en: Vihavya had a own begotten son who was named Vitatya, and Vitatya had a son of name Satya. Satya had a son of name Santa.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा ते सर्वे ययुर्देवा यथागतम्। ततो राजर्षयः सर्वे संगताः परमर्षयः॥ सभाज्य मुद्रिता रामं सागस्त्या इदमब्रुवन्।
en: Saying this all the deities went to from where they had come. Then the Rājarşis in company with supreme saints, with Agastya (at their head), gladly paying homage to Rāma, said the following words.

sa: तैस्तस्य तु महाराज भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ द्वाभ्यां स सारथिं ह्या द् भीमं सप्तभिरेव च। ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छेद द्वाभ्यां छत्रं विशाम्पते॥ चतुर्भिश्चतुरो वाहान् विव्याध सुबलात्मजः।
en: And the son of Subala, O king, hit the chariot-driver with two and Bhima with seven; struck off the banner with one and the umbrella with two; and pierced, O lord of the universe, the four chargers with the remaining four chargers with the remaining four of those broad-headed shafts.

sa: अधर्ममेनं विपुलं धार्मिकः सन् न बुद्ध्यसे। यत् त्वमात्मानमस्मांश्च प्रशस्यान् न प्रशंससि॥
en: Pious as you are, you do not know the nature of impiety, for you do not offer us applause though we are worthy of it.

sa: छिद्रं तु तस्य तद् दृष्ट्वा प्रोचुस्ते पूर्वमन्त्रिणः॥ सर्वेषामेव सोऽस्माकं वृत्तिभङ्गे प्रवर्तते।
en: Finding the opportunity, the former ministers said to the king,-The jackal is always ready to take away from all of us the means of sustenance.

sa: यदि विप्रत्ययो ह्येष तदिदं दर्शयाम ते॥ तन्मांसं चैव गोमायोस्तैः क्षणादाशु ढौकितम्।
en: If you disbelieve this, we will give you proof!-Having said so, they immediately caused that meat to be found out by entering the jackal's house.

sa: इति ब्रुवाणं राजानं रामः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्। 'कुरु प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कैकेय्या भरतस्य च॥
en: The king speaking thus Rāma spoke to him with folded hands saying, “O you conversant with piety, do you be propitiated with Bharata and Kaikeyi.

sa: स्वयमेवात्मानो दोषान् ब्रुवाणः किन्न लज्जसे। दारयेयं महीं क्रोधाद् विकिरेयं च पर्वतान्॥
en: Disclosing your own weakness, it is strange that you fell no shame! I can rend this earth open in rage and split the very mountains.

sa: विबुधात्मनि दृश्यन्ते त्वयि वीर प्रशासति॥ अमानुषाणि सत्त्वानि व्याहृतानि मुहुर्मुहुः। अनामयश्च मानां साग्रो मासो गतो ह्ययम् ।।१८ जीर्णानामपि सत्त्वानां मृत्यु याति राघव। अरोगप्रसवा नार्यो वपुष्मन्तो हि मानवाः॥
en: O hero, during your divine administration, we have seen many inhuman creatures and objects speak like men. During all these months since your installation subjects have not suffered from any disease. Even the most aged animals have not met with death. The female, without any risk, have been giving birth to children and all people are plump and delighted.

sa: तत्रारावो महानासीद् द्रोणमेकं युयुत्सताम्। पाण्डवानां च भद्रं ते सृञ्जयानां च सर्वशः॥
en: May good betide you; the din that then arose there, when the Pandavas and the Srinjaya rushed against the single-handed Drona, was indeed very tremendous.

sa: इयं च वसुधा कृत्स्ना प्रसादात् तव केशव। अस्मानुपगता वीर निहताश्चापि शत्रवः॥
en: It is through your grace, O Keshava that the whole Earth, O hero, has come under our sway and all our enemies have been killed.

sa: भूतानि चैव सर्वाणि अग्रतः पृष्ठतोऽपि वा। उच्छिष्टं वापि च्छिद्रेषु वर्जयन्ति तपोधनाः॥
en: As regards Rishis having penances for wealth they always avoid all creatures both before and behind, as also all that is impure, while performing Shraddhas.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स तथा याचमानस्य मुनिरग्निसमप्रभः। जमदग्निः शमं नैव जगाम कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Bhishma said O descendant of Kuru, inspite of all the prayers of the Sun, the sage Jamadagni, effulgent like fire, continued to cherish his anger.

sa: यथा तयो रक्षणं च मदयन्त्यभिभाषितम्। तथा ते कुण्डले बद्ध्वा तदा कृष्णाजिनेऽनयत्॥
en: Protecting them even in the manner directed by Madayanti, that is, binding them within the folds of his black, deer-skin, he proceeded on his way.

sa: न प्रबोध्योऽस्मि संसुप्त इत्युवाचाथ भार्गवः। संवाहितव्यौ मे पादौ जागृतव्यं च तेऽनिशम्॥
en: The Rishi told them-Do not, while I sleep, awake me! Do you keep yourself awake and continually press my feet as long as I sleep.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा परमं रूपं विष्णोर्वैष्णवमद्भुतम्। विस्मयं च ययौ विप्रस्तं दृष्ट्वा परमेश्वरम्॥
en: Sceing that high and wonderful Vaishnava form of Vishnu, in fact, seeing the Supreme Lord in (that guise) the Brahmana Utanka became filled with wonder.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उक्तास्तु भवता भोज्यास्तथाभोज्याश्च सर्वशः। अत्र में प्रश्नसंदेहस्तन्मे वद पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have told me fully of those from whom food may be taken and of those from whom it should not be taken?

sa: असद्धर्मस्त्वयं स्त्रीणामस्माकं भवति प्रभो। पापीयसो नरान् यद् वै लज्जां त्यक्त्वा भजामहे॥१४
en: This, O powerful one, is a sinful disposition with us women, casting off modesty, we seek the companionship of men of sinful habits and intentions.

sa: किं वयं कारिताः पूर्वे भवत्या पृथिवीक्षयम्। कस्य हेतोः परित्यज्य वनं गन्तुमभीप्ससि॥
en: Why then did you causc us to exterminate the Earth? Why would you leave all and wish to take up your residence in the forest?

sa: यदुरापं दुराम्नायं दुराधर्षं दुरन्वयम्। तत् सर्वं तपसा साध्यं तपो हि दुरतिक्रमम्॥
en: Whatever is difficult of acquisition, difficult to learn, difficult to defeat, difficult to pass through, can all be acquired by penance, for penance is irresistible.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच बृहस्पतिवचः श्रुत्वा शक्रो विगतमत्सरः। प्रशस्यैनं विवेशाथ स्वमेव भवनं तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said On hearing these words of Brihaspati, Indra became freed from his envious feelings, and then lauding him he repaired to his own palace.

sa: अन्नेन सदृशं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति। तस्मादन्नं विशेषेण दातुमिच्छन्ति मानवाः॥
en: There has never been, nor will be, any gift equal to the gift of food. Hence, men always wish particularly to make gifts of food.

sa: सा च तीर्व तपस्तेपे महाभागा यशस्विनी। उतथ्यार्थे तु चार्वङ्गी परं नियममास्थिता॥
en: The famous and highly blessed maiden of faultless limbs, observing various vows practised the severest austerities from the desire of getting Utathya for her husband.

sa: यस्तु वैश्यैः सहाश्नीयाद् ब्राह्मणोऽप्येकभोजने। स वै त्रिरात्रं दीक्षित्वा मुच्यते तेन कर्मणा॥
en: The Brahmana who takes his food in the company of Vaishyas, is purged off of all sins, by living on alms for three successive nights.

sa: ईदृशः स महादेवो भूयश्च भगवानतः। न हि शक्या गुणा वक्तुमपि वर्षशतैरपि॥
en: Even such is Mahadeva. He is, again, that god who is unborn. In even a hundred years, one cannot exhaust his merits by rccounting them.

sa: गुरुशुश्रूषया चैव जननी ते जनाधिप। प्राप्ता सुमहतीं सिद्धिमिति मे नात्र संशयः॥
en: Through service rendered by her to her seniors, your mother, O king, has acquired very great success. There is not the slightest doubt of this.

sa: एष ब्रह्मा शिवो रुद्रो वरुणोऽग्निः प्रजापतिः। कीर्त्यते भगवान् देवः सर्वभूतपतिः शिवः॥
en: That illustrious god is called by various names. He is Brahman, Shiva, Rudra, Varuna, Agni and Prajapati, He is the auspicious Lord of all creatures.

sa: तासु चैव महापुण्यं शुश्रूषा च महाफलम्। अहन्यहनि धर्मेण युज्यते वै गवाह्निकः॥
en: Respectful services done to them, yield great merit and grave results. That man who every day gives food to kine daily, acquires accumulated religious merits.

sa: ब्राह्मणेष्वार्जवं यच्च स्थैर्यं च धरणीतले। सौम्यतां चैव सोमस्य गाम्भीर्यं वरुणस्य च॥ दीप्तिमग्नेः प्रभां मेरोः प्रतापं तपनस्य च। एतान्यतिक्रमेद् यो वै स हन्याच्छरणागतम्॥
en: He would get over the simplicity that exists in Brahmanas, the stability that exists in the Earth, the mildness existing in the Moon, the gravity existing in Varuna, the effulgence existing in Agni, the brightness of Meru, and the heat of the Sun, who would kill a suppliant for protection.

sa: नाहमात्मार्थमिच्छामि मनो नित्यं मनोऽन्तरे। मनो मे निर्जितं तस्माद् वशे तिष्ठन्ति नित्यदा॥
en: I do not wish for my own self the mind that is always in my mind. Therefore the mind, subjugated by me, is under me.

sa: प्राणधारणमात्रेण शक्यं कर्तुं तपस्त्वया। प्राणो हि परमो धर्मः स्थितो देहेषु देहिनाम्॥
en: By living on barely you are capable of practicing penances. The life-breath is the great deity which lives in the bodies of all embodied creatures.'

sa: ततः प्रणेमुर्देवास्ते वेपमानाः स्म शङ्करम्। पुनश्च संदधे रुद्रो दीप्तं सुनिशितं शरम्॥
en: Trembling with fear, the celestials bent their heads to Shankara. Without being appeased, Rudra once more placed on his bowstring a sharp and blazing arrow.

sa: पाण्डवाः सर्वकार्याणि सम्पृच्छन्ति स्म तं नृपम्। चक्रुस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञाता वर्षाणि दश पञ्च च॥
en: The Pandavas used to consult that king in all matters. Indeed, for fifteen years, they did all things under the advice of the old king.

sa: तत्र सामानि गायन्ति तत्र चाहुर्निदर्शनम्। देवं नारायणं भीरु सर्वात्मानं निबोध तम्॥
en: Then are sung some Samans. There is an authority on this subject. O timid one, know that the divine Narayana is the Soul of all.

sa: एवं तव प्रपश्यामि श्रेयो भृगुकुलोद्वह। आगच्छतो हि ते विप्र भवेन्मृत्युर्न संशयः॥
en: O perpetuator of Bhrigu's race, by acting thus, you will secure your well-being. If you return, O learned Brahmana, you will surely meet with death.

sa: फलभक्षेण राजर्षे पश्य कर्मात्रिणा कृतम्। तस्यापि विस्तरेणोक्तं कर्मात्रेः सुमहात्मनः। ब्रवीम्यहं ब्रूहि वा त्वमत्रितः क्षत्रियं वरम्॥
en: I have thus described to you, in full, the feat of the great Atri. Shail I go on? Or, will you say anything? Is there a Kshatriya who is superior to this twiceborn Rishi?

sa: सर्वभूतेषु यो विद्वान् ददात्यभयदक्षिणाम्। दाता भवति लोके स प्राणानां नात्र संशयः॥
en: That learned person who gives to all living creatures the gift of complete assurance, is forsooth, regarded as the giver of lifc-breaths in this world.

sa: तवे सर्व: सुविदितः स्त्रीधर्मः शाश्वत: शुभे। तस्मादशेषतो ब्रूहि स्वधर्म विस्तरेण मे॥
en: O auspicious lady, you know all the eternal duties of women. Do you, therefore, tell me in full what the duties are of your sex.

sa: वाजिनां श्यामकर्णानां हरितानां पितामह। प्रादां हेमस्रजां ब्रह्मन् कोटीर्दश च सप्त च॥
en: I also gave away seventeen crors of horses, O Grandfather, each of green colour, each having black ears, and each adorned with garlands of gold.

sa: संचयांश्च न कुर्वीत स्नेहवासं च वर्जयेत्। पूताभिरद्भिर्नित्यं वै कार्यं कुर्वीत मोक्षवित्॥
en: He should never amass riches and should avoid living with friends. The man knowing Liberation should every day do all his acts with pure water.

sa: प्रमदाश्च यथा सृष्टा ब्रह्मणा भरतर्षभ। यदर्थं तच्च ते तात प्रवक्ष्यामि नराधिप।॥
en: I shall also tell you, O king, how women were created by the Grandfather Brahman and the object for which they were created by him.

sa: गम्यतां स्वपुरं पुत्र विश्रान्तः पुनरेष्यसि। इहस्थं मां सभार्यस्त्वं द्रष्टासि श्वो नराधिप॥
en: Do you return to your city. You are exhausted! You shall come again. Tomorrow, O king, you shall returning with your wife, see me here.

sa: उदकं चक्रिरे चैव गाङ्गेयस्य महात्मनः॥ विधिवत् क्षत्रियश्रेष्ठाः स च सर्वो जनस्तदा।
en: to All of them, the foremost of the Kshatriyas, arrived at the sacred river, duly offered Oblations of water to the great son of Ganga.

sa: कान्तारे ब्राह्मणान् गाश्च यः परित्राति कौशिक। क्षणेन विप्रमुच्येत तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु।॥
en: rescues That person who kine and Brahmanas in the forest, O Kaushika, is himself rescued from every sort of danger. Hear what his merit is.

sa: कोटीसहस्रं वर्षाणां त्रीणि कोटिशतानि च॥ पद्मान्यष्टादश तथा पताके द्वे तथैव च।
en: He leads such a happy life for ten thousand millions of years and three thousand millions besides and eight and ten Padmas and two Patakas.

sa: गान्धार्या सहितो धीमान् वध्वा कुन्त्या समन्वितः। संजयेन च सूतेन साग्निहोज्ञः सयाजकः॥
en: That intelligent king took with him his (sacred) fire, Gandhari and his daughter-in-law Kunti, as also Sanjaya of the Suta caste, and all the Yajakas.

sa: अहो ब्राह्मणकर्माणि मया मारुत तत्त्वतः। त्वया प्रोक्तानि कात्स्न्येन श्रुतानि प्रयतेन च॥
en: Oh, I have with attention, heard the achievements, O god of wind, of the Brahmanas with all their interesting details as described by you truly.

sa: तत्र सामानि गायन्ति तत्र चाहुर्निदर्शनम्। देवं नारायणं भीरु सर्वात्मानं निबोध तम्॥
en: Then are sung some Samans. There is an authority on this subject. O timid one, know that the divine Narayana is the Soul of all.

sa: स ततस्तानि जग्राह दिव्यानि रुचिराणि च। प्राप्तानि स्वेन तापसा दिव्यगन्धानि भारत॥
en: He took up those exquisitely beautiful celestial flowers. Possessed of celestial fragrance, O Bharata, Vipula got them there as the result of his severe penances.

sa: घ्राण जिह्वा च चक्षुश्च त्वक् श्रोत्रं बुद्धिरेव च। संशयं नाधिगच्छन्ति मनस्नमधिगच्छति॥
en: The nose, the tongue, the cye, the skin, the car, and the understanding, never succeed in apprchending doubt. It is the mind which apprehends it.

sa: वसूनां मरुतां चैव साध्यानामश्विनोस्तथा॥ रुद्राणां च तथा लोकं ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति।
en: The regions he attains are those of the Vasus and the Maruts, of the Saddhyas and the Ashvins, of the Rudras and of Brahman himself.

sa: उपवासं च दीक्षां च अभिषेकं च पार्थिव। कृत्वा द्वादशवर्षाणि वीरस्थानाद् विशिष्यते॥
en: By observing fasts and initiation and baths, O Bharata, for twelve years one acquires a region which is superior to that attainable by unreturning heroes.

sa: गाश्च शुक्षूषते यश्च समन्वेति च सर्वशः। तस्मै तुष्टाः प्रयच्छन्ति वरानपि सुदुर्लभान्॥
en: He who serves kine with respect and who follows them with humility, succeeds in getting many invaluable boons from kine who become pleased with him.

sa: विप्रियं च जनस्यास्य संसर्गाद् धर्मजस्य वै॥ न करिष्यन्ति राजर्षे तथा भीमार्जुनादयः।
en: From association with him who is the son of Dharma, O royal sage, Bhima and Arjuna and others will never wrong us in the least.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अयं दैवतवंशो वै ऋषिवंशसमन्वितः। त्रिसंध्यं पठितः पुत्र कल्मषापहरः परः॥
en: Bhishma said O son, the following names of the celestials with those of the Rishis, if duly recited morning, noon, and evening, destroy all sins.

sa: तपसा प्राप्यते स्वर्गस्तपसा प्राप्यते यशः। आयुः प्रकृर्षो भोगाश्च लभ्यन्ते तपसा विभो॥
en: One goes to Heaven by penances. By penances one acquires fame. By penances, O mighty king, one lives long and gets all articles of enjoyment.

sa: श्रान्ताय क्षुधितायानं यः प्रयच्छति भूमिपः। स्वायम्भुवं महत् स्थानं स गच्छति नराधिप॥
en: That king, who makes a gift of food to one who is toil-worn and hungry, acquires the regions of supreme happiness belonging to the Self-create.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच उत्तको महता युक्तस्तपसा जनमेजय। गुरुभक्तः स तेजस्वी नान्यत् किंचिदपूजयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Janamejaya, Utanka was gifted with austere penances. He was devoted to his preceptor. Gifted with great energy, he abstained from adoring anybody else.

sa: द्वादशैव तथाऽऽदित्यान् वामपार्वे समास्थितान्। अग्रतश्चैव मे पश्य वसूनष्टौ सुरोत्तमान्॥ नासत्यं चैव दस्रं च भिषजौ पश्य पृष्ठतः। सर्वान् प्रजापतीन् पश्य पश्य सप्त ऋषींस्तथा॥
en: The twelve Adityas are on the left side of my person. See the eight Vasus, those foremnost of gods, are in my front, and see, Nasatya and Dasra, those two celestial physicians, are in the rear. See also in my body all the Prajapatis and see the seven Rishis Also.

sa: चत्वारस्ते वयं शिष्या गुरुपुत्रश्च पञ्चमः। इह वेदाः प्रतिष्ठेरन्नेषः नः कासितो वरः॥
en: We are four. Our preceptor's son forms the fifth. Let the Vedas shine in only us five! This is the boon that we pray for.

sa: त्रिविधा वेदना चैव सर्वसत्त्वेषु दृश्यते॥ सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति भारत।
en: Three kinds of intelligence also are seen in every creature, viz., that which depends upon Goodness, that upon darkness, and that upon Ignorance, O Bharata.

sa: दुर्लभो हि सुहच्छ्रोता दुर्लभश्च हितः सुहृत्। एतद् धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ सर्वं व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: A friend capable of hearing beneficial advice, and also of doing good, is highly rare! You should foremost of virtuous men, describe fully those subjects.

sa: स सृष्ट्वा पृथिवीं चैव सर्वभूतेश्वरः प्रभुः। अप्स्वेव भवनं चक्रे महात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: Having created the Earth that powerful Lord of all things, that great one, that foremost of all beings, lay on the surface of the waters.

sa: शोचन्तस्तस्य पूर्वोक्तान् भाषितांश्चासकृत् पुनः। तं बालं भूतले क्षिप्य प्रतिगन्तुं न शक्नुयुः॥
en: Remembering with sorrowful hearts the former speeches of their minion again and again, they could not return home casting the body on the naked earth.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच वहवः पुरुषा ब्रह्मन्नुताहो एक एव तु। को ह्यत्र पुरुषः श्रेष्ठः को वा योनिरिहोच्यते॥
en: Janamejaya said O twice-born one, are there many souls or is there only one? Who, in the universe, is the foremost of Souls? What, again, is said to be the source of all things?

sa: कृषिश्च पाशुपाल्यं च वाणिज्यं च विशामपि। द्विजानां परिचर्या च शूद्रकर्म नराधिप॥
en: Agriculture, cattle-tending, and trade are the duties, of the Vaishyas. While service of the (three) twice-born classes is the duty, 0 king, of the Shudras.

sa: तण्डि उवाच ब्रह्मा शतक्रतुर्विष्णुर्विश्वेदेवा महर्षयः न विदुस्त्वामिति ततस्तुष्टः प्रोवाच तं शिवः॥
en: Tandi said Neither Brahman, nor Indra, nor Vishnu, nor the Vishvedevas, nor the great Rishis, know you. Pleased at this Shiva Said the following words.

sa: भीष्म उवाच श्रुतोऽयमर्थो रामस्य जामदग्न्यस्य जल्पतः। नारदस्य च देवर्षेः कृष्णद्वैपायनस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said I have heard of this subject from Jamadagni's son Rama while he described it from the celestial saint Narada and from Krishna-Dvaipayana. to

sa: इति संचिन्त्य मनसा कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्॥ स चोपविविशे तत्र पीठे कुशमये शुभे।
en: Thinking thus, he went round them both and then sat down on the excellent seat made of Kusha grass that had been offered to him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतद् वै सर्वमाख्यातं मुनिना सुमहात्मना। विदेहराजाय पुरा श्रेयसोऽर्थे नराधिप॥
en: Bhishma continued All this was said by that great sage to the king of the Videhas, O king, in days of yore for his well-being.

sa: उच्छ्राया विनिपातान्ता भावोऽभावः स एव च॥ अनित्यमध्रुवं सर्वं व्यवसायो हि दुष्करः।
en: What is existent is only another form of the non-existent. Every thing is transitory and unstable. It is difficult to arrive at such a conviction.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथ सा स्त्री तमुवाच बाढमेवं भवत्विति। तैलं दिव्यमुपादाय स्नानशाटीमुपानयत्॥
en: Bhishma said Thus ordered the lady said Be it so! She then brought oil and a piece of cloth for his wear during the ablutions.

sa: तामाहूय तदा देवो लोकानामादिरीश्वरः। मृत्यो इति महीपाल जहि चेमाः प्रजा इति॥
en: Then, O king, the powerful Self-create, the prime Cause of all the worlds, saluted her and said, O Death, kill these creatures of the universe.

sa: नारदेन पुरा राजन् गुरवे मे निवेदितम्। ऋषीणां पाण्डवानां च शृण्वतोः कृष्णभीष्मयो॥
en: Formerly Narada had recounted it to my preceptor before many Rishis and the son of Pandu and in the presence of Krishna and Bhishma also.

sa: अभिध्यापूर्वकं जप्यं कुरुते यश्च मोहितः। यत्राभिध्यां स कुरुते तं वै निरयमृच्छति॥
en: That man who makes silent recitation under the influence of stupefaction and from desire of fruit, acquires all those things which he seeks at heart.

sa: तत्राप्येवंविधा लोके वृत्तिः सत्यानृते भवेत्। धर्माधर्मी प्रकाशश्च तमो दुःखं सुखं तथा॥
en: In this world also, Truth and Untruth bring on contrary action and contrary indications, such as Righteousness and Unrighteousness, Light and Darkness, Pleasure and Pain.

sa: इहैनं दैवतश्रेष्ठं देवाः सर्षिगणाः पुरा। तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण सत्येन च दमेन च॥ तोषयित्वा शुभान कामान् प्राप्तवन्तो जनार्दन। तेजसां तपसां चैव निधिः स भगवानिह॥
en: O Janarddana, it was here that the gods with ali the Rishis, in days of yore, pleased that foremost of gods by their penances and celibacy and Truth and selfcontrol, and succeeded in realizing many high hopes. That illustrious god is verily the inexhaustible source of all energies and penances.

sa: अष्टवक्र उवाच नास्ति स्वतन्त्रता स्त्रीणामस्वतन्त्रा हि योषितः। प्रजापतिमतं ह्येतन्न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति॥
en: Ashtavakra said Women can never be their own mistresses. This is the opinion of the Creator himself, viz., that a woman should never be indepent.

sa: यथा चानिमिषाः स्थूला जालं छित्त्वा पुनर्जलम्। प्राप्नुवन्ति तथा योगास्तत् पदं वीतकल्मषाः॥
en: As large fishes, breaking through the net pass into their own element, similarly, Yogins, become purged of all sins and acquire the happiness of Liberation.

sa: बलहीनाश्च कौन्तेय यथा जालं गता झषाः। वधं गच्छन्ति राजेन्द्र योगास्तद्वत् सुदुर्बलाः॥
en: As weak fishes, O son of Kunti, fallen into the net, become entangled in it, so, O king, shorn of Yoga power meet with destruction.

sa: तामुवाच ततो माता सुतां सत्यवती तदा। पुत्रि पूर्वोपपन्नायाः कुरुष्व वचनं मम॥
en: Then the mother, addressing her daughter Satyavati, said: O daughter, as I deserve greater respect from you than your husband, do you obey my words.

sa: इत्येवं चोदितो देव्या तामवोचं सुमध्यमाम्। अनुजानीहि मां राज्ञि करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
en: Thus addressed by the princess, I replied to her having slender waist Let me have your permission, O queen! I shall certainly obey your command.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथ वैवस्वत: कालो मृत्युश्च त्रितयं विभो। ब्राह्मणं तं महाभागमुपगम्येदमब्रुवन्॥
en: Bhishma said After Dharma has said this, the three Vivasvat's son (Yama), Time and Mrityu, approached that Brahmana, 0 blessed king, and addressed him thus.

sa: तदेष तपसां शत्रुः श्रेयसां विनिपातकः। निगृहीतो मया रोषः श्रुत्वैवं वचनं तव॥
en: Verily, O amiable lady, at your words I have controlled my anger, that enemy of penances, that destroyer of all that is beneficial for himself.

sa: इत्येतद् वृत्रमाश्रित्य शक्रस्यात्यद्भुतं महत्। कथितं कर्म ते तात किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: I have now recited to you one of the greatest and most wonderful feats of Indra about Vritra, What else do you wish to hear."

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं ब्रह्मर्षिः सुमहातपाः। प्रातिष्ठत शुकः सिद्धिं हित्वा दोषांश्चतुर्विधान्॥
en: Bhishma said “Having spoken in this way, the twice-born Rishi of austere penances, viz., Shuka, lived on his success, renouncing the four sorts of faults.

sa: तमतिक्रम्य नागेन्द्रो मतिमान् स नरेश्वर। प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं प्रकृत्या धर्मवत्सलः॥ भो भो क्षाम्याभिभाषे त्वां न रोषं कर्तुमर्हसि। इह त्वमभिसम्प्राप्तः कस्यार्थे किं प्रयोजनम्॥
en: Arrived before him, O king of men, that foremost of Nagas, devoted by his nature to virtue, addressed his guest in sweet words, saying,-0 Brahmana, do not give way to anger. I address you in peace! Do not be angry! For whom have you come here? What is your object?

sa: आभिमुख्यादभिक्रम्य स्नेहात् पृच्छामि ते द्विजा विविक्ते गोमतीतीरे कं वा त्वं पर्युपाससे॥
en: Coming to you, I ask you in love, O twiceborn one! Whom do you worship in this retired spot on the banks of the Gomati?

sa: वाप्यः पुनर्योजनविस्तृतास्ताः क्रोशं च गम्भीरतयावगाढाः। आयामतः पञ्चशताश्च सर्वाः प्रत्येकशो योजनतः प्रवृद्धाः॥
en: Conceive a lake that is one Yojana in width, one Krosha is depth, and five hundred Yojanas in length. Imagine many thousands of such lakes.

sa: को हि शक्तो भवं ज्ञातुं मद्विधः परमेश्वरम्। ऋते नारायणात् पुत्र शङ्खचक्रगदाधरात्॥
en: Being such, what man like me understand Bhava? Only Narayana, O son, that holder of the conch, the discus, and the mace, can comprehend Mahadeva.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच सैवाद्यापि प्रतिज्ञा मे स्वशक्त्या किं प्रदीयताम्। ब्रूहि दास्यामि राजेन्द्र विभवे सति मा चिरम्॥
en: The Brahmana said As regards myself, this is my resolution today. What shall I give you according to my might? Tell me, O king of kings, and I shall give you. Do not delay.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोध आनृशंस्यं दमस्तथा। आर्जवं चैव राजेन्द्र निश्चितं धर्मलक्षणम्॥
en: Bhishma said Abstention from injury to others, truthfulness, the absence of anger, mercy, selfcontrol and sincerity or candour, o king, are the marks of virtue.

sa: तण्डिः प्रोवाच शुक्राय गौतमाय च भार्गवः। वैवस्वताय मनवे गौतमः प्राह माधव॥
en: Tandi communicated it to Shukra and Shukra of Bhrigu's race communicated it to Gautama. Gautama, again, O descendant of Madhu, communicated it to Vaivasvata Manu.

sa: यथा जतु च काष्ठं च पांसवश्चोदबिन्दवः। संश्लिष्टानि तथा राजन् प्राणिनामिह सम्भवः॥
en: As lac and wood, as grains of dust and drops of water, exist mixed up when brought together, so are the existence of all creatures.

sa: यश्चैष पुरुषो जात: स्वेदात् ते विबुधोत्तम। ज्वरो नामैष धर्मज्ञ लोकेषु प्रचरिष्यति॥
en: This Being, also, that has originated from your sweat, O foremost of gods, shall walk among creatures, O righteous-souled one, under the name of Fever.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच हन्त ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यदेतदनुपृच्छसि। योगकृत्यं महाराज पृथगेव शृणुष्व मे॥
en: Vashishtha said I shall tell you what you ask. Listen, however, to me, O king, as I explain to you the practices of Yoga separately.

sa: पुत्र उवाच मृत्युनाभ्याहतो लोको जरया परिवारितः। अहोरात्राः पतन्तीमे तच्च कस्मान्न बुद्ध्यसे॥
en: The world is attacked by Death. It is attacked by Decrepitude. Days and Nights are continually falling. Why do you not take care of these.

sa: ते पिबन्तः कषायांश्च सपौषि विविधानि च। दृश्यन्ते जरया भग्ना नगा नागैरिवोत्तमैः॥
en: Even if men drink many astringents and various sorts of medicated ghee, they are seen to be broken by decrepitude like trees by strong elephants.

sa: यज्ञैर्ये चापि यक्ष्यन्ति सर्वलोकेषु वै सुराः॥ कल्पयिष्यन्ति वो भागांस्ते नरा वेदकल्पितान्।
en: You gods, those men also that will celebrate sacrifices, according to the Vedic ordinances, will give to all of you, shares of their sacrificial offerings.

sa: ब्राह्मणा: क्षत्रिया वैश्यास्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः। एतेषु कथयन् राजन् ब्राह्मणो न प्रदुष्यति॥
en: Brahmanas and Kshatriyas and Vaishyas, these three orders, are considered as twice born. By delivering instruction to these, a Brahmana does not commit any sin.

sa: दृष्ट्वा च सहिताः सर्वे दैत्याः सत्त्वममानुषम्। प्रसह्य तरसा सर्वे संतस्थुः कालमोहिताः॥
en: Seeing that extraordinary creature, all the Daityas, in a body stupefied by Time, quickly proceeded against it for displaying their strength, and stood encircling it.

sa: रसां पुनः प्रविष्टश्च योगं परममास्थितः॥ शैक्ष्यं स्वरं समास्थाय उद्गीतं प्रासृजत् स्वरम्।
en: Having reached those regions he began Yoga. Adopting a voice governed by the rules of the science called Shiksha, he began to chant Vedic Mantras,

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु राजन् कथां दिव्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम्। नृपतेर्मुचुकुन्दस्य कथितां भार्गवेण वै॥
en: Listen, O king, to this most Beautiful story which cleanses the hearer of every sin, and which Bhrigu's son (Rama) had recited to king Muchukunda.

sa: भीष्म उवाच पुराहं मृगयां यातो मार्कण्डेयाश्रमे स्थितः। तत्रापश्यं मुनिगणान् समासीनान् सहस्रशः॥
en: 'Formerly, on one occasion, while out on hunting, I arrived at the asylum of Markandeya. There I saw various classes of ascetics seated by thousands.

sa: न भयं क्रोधचापल्ये न शोकस्तेषु विद्यते। न धर्मध्वजिनश्चैव न गुह्यं कञ्चिदास्थिताः॥
en: Fear, anger, restlessness, and sorrow do not live in them. They carry no external garb of religion for misleading their fellow-men. They observe no mystery.

sa: एवमस्त्विति होवाच स्वां भार्यो सुमहातपाः। ततः सा जनयामास जमदग्निं सुतं शुभम्॥
en: Be it so, said that Rishi of austere penances to his wife and then, O king, she gave birth to a blessed son named Jamadagni.

sa: यस्य दस्युगणा राष्ट्र ध्वांक्षा मत्स्यान् जलादिव। विहरन्ति परस्वानि स वै क्षत्रियपासनः॥
en: He is a wretch among Kshatriyas in whose kingdom robbers go about pillaging the property of other people like crows taking little fishes from water.

sa: राज्ञस्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमानभवद् द्विजः। पूजयित्वा च तद् वाक्यं माण्डव्यो मोक्षमाश्रितः॥
en: Hearing these words of the king, the Brahmana became filled with joy, and speaking highly of what he heard, Mandavya followed the path of Liberation.

sa: उभे सत्यानृते त्यक्त्वा शोकानन्दौ प्रियाप्रिये। भयाभयं च संत्यज्य स प्रशान्तो निरामयः॥
en: By shaking off both truth and falsehood, grief and joy, the agreeable and disagreeable, fearlessness and fear, one acquires tranquillity, and becomes free from anxiety.

sa: देवानां तु सकाशाद् वै ततः श्रुत्वासितो द्विजः॥ श्रावयामास राजेन्द्र पितॄणां मुनिसत्तमः।
en: The best of ascetics, viz., the regener: Asita, then, having heard the narrative from the gods, repeated it to the Pitris, O king of kings.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि नरे पञ्च षष्ठं तु मन उच्यते। सप्तमी बुद्धिमेवाहुः क्षेत्रज्ञः पुनरष्टमः॥
en: In man there are five senses. The sixth (sense) is the Mind. The seventh is called the Understanding. The Kshetrajna or Soul is the eighth.

sa: यथैव शृङ्गं गोः काले वर्धमानस्य वर्धते। तथैव तृष्णा वित्तेन वर्धमानेन वर्धते॥
en: As the horns of a cow grow with the growth of the cow itself, similarly the thirst for riches multiplies with increasing acquisitions of wealth.

sa: संनिकृष्टश्च देवस्य न चान्यैर्मानुषैर्वृतः। एष मे दास्यति धनं प्रभूतं शीघ्रमेव च।॥
en: He lives near the gods. He has not as yet been worshipped by other man. He will surely give me profuse riches without any delay!

sa: शब्दश्रोत्रे तथा खानि त्रयमाकाशयोनिजम्। रसः स्नेहश्च जिह्वा च अपामेते गुणाः स्मृताः॥
en: Sound, the cars, and all cavities,-these three-have ether for their cause. Taste, all watery or juicy substances, and the tongue, are the properties of Water.

sa: राजसी तामसी चैव व्यामिश्रे प्रकृती स्मृते। तदात्मकं हि पुरुषं जायमानं विशाम्पते॥
en: No one, O king, can become awakened through his own wishes. That nature which partakes of both Darkness and Ignorance is said to be mixed.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्त्वा निववृत्ते मातङ्गः कौशिकं तदा। विश्वामित्रो जाहरैव कृतबुद्धिः श्वजाघनीम्॥
en: Bhishma said Having said these words to Kushika's son, the Chandala became silent, Vishvamitra then, of refined understanding, took away that haunch of dog's meat.

sa: एवं हि स महाभागो नारदो गुरवे मम। श्वेतानां यतिनां चाह एकान्तगतिमव्ययाम्॥
en: Thus did the highly-blessed Narada explain to my preceptor.-the Island-born Krishna-the eternal and immutable course called Ekanta, followed by the Whites as also by Yatis.

sa: अज्ञानाद्धि कृतं पापं तपसैवाभिनिर्णदेत्। पापं हि कर्म फलति पापमेव स्वयं कृतम्।
en: All sinful deeds that are perpetrated unconsciously or in ignorance are destroyed by penances. A sinful deed, however, that is committed knowingly, yields much sorrow.

sa: यतः सृष्टानि तत्रैव तानि यान्ति पुनः पुनः। महाभूतानि भूतेभ्यः सागरस्योर्मयो यथा।॥
en: To Him from whom these great primal elements spring, they return again and again severing themselves from all creatures like the wave of the ocean.

sa: उक्ताः स्मो यद् भगवता तदात्वायतिसंहितम्। तन्नो मनसि संरूढं करिष्यामस्तथा च तत्॥
en: Addressing one another, these said,-We will remember and act according to what has been said by our illustrious preceptor in view of our future well-being.

sa: स्वरूपिणी ततो बुद्धिरुपतस्थे हरि प्रभुम्। योगेन चैनां निर्योगः स्वयं नियुयुजे तदा॥
en: Possessed of form that resembled immediately appeared before the powerful Hari. Himself above all Yoga, Narayana then, with Yoga, applied the goddess of Intelligence properly.

sa: व्यास उवाच यस्मादनादृत्य कृतं त्वयास्मान् कर्म दारुणम् ब्राह्मणस्य सतश्चैव यस्मात् ते वृत्तमीदृशम्॥ तस्माद् यद् देवकीपुत्र उक्तवानुत्तमं वचः असंशयं ते तद् भावि क्षत्रधर्मस्त्वयाऽऽश्रितः॥
en: Vyasa said Since, obeying us, you have committed this highly cruel act, and since your conduct is such, although you are a good Brahmana by birth, therefore, those excellent words that Devaki's son had said, will, forsooth, be fulfilled regarding you, because you are living the life of a Kshatriya.'

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे पराजित्य नराधिपम्। अपक्रान्ते तव सुते हयपृष्ठं समाश्रिते॥ दृष्ट्वा च पाण्डवान् सर्वान् कुञ्जरैः परिवारितान्।
en: Dhrishtadyumna, after the defeat of the Kuru king in battle and after the fight of the latter from that spot of horse-back, saw that the Pandavas had all been encircled by the Kaurava elephants.

sa: ततः प्रववृते रौद्रः संग्रामः शोणितोदकः। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनः॥ ते दृष्ट्वा
en: Then took place an awful battle, in which blood flowed as water, between the Pandavas and the Kurus, that increased the denizens of Yama's region.

sa: एकान्तेन हि सर्वेषां न शक्यं तात रोचितुम्। मित्रामित्रमथो मध्यं सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥
en: No man, O sire, can acquire the golden opinion of all persons in the world. All persons have friends, foes, and indifferent ones, O Bharata.

sa: इदं दुःखतरं मेऽद्य यदिमा मुक्तमूर्धजाः। हतपुत्रा रणे बालाः परिधावन्ति मे स्नुषाः॥
en: That which pains me more to-day is that these my young daughter-in-law, deprived of sons and with disheveled hairs, are wandering on the field today.

sa: नैकान्तविनिपातेन विचचारेह कश्चन। धर्मी गृही वा राजा वा ब्रह्मचारी यथा पुनः॥
en: No person, be he a virtuous house-holder, or be he a king, or be he a Brahmacharin, has ever succeeded in conducting himself without failure.

sa: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच अत्र ते वर्णयिष्यामि यथावृत्तं जनेश्वर। नारदः पर्वतश्चैव द्वावृषी लोकसत्तमौ॥
en: Krishna said 'I will recount, О king, the incidents as they took place. There are two Rishis foremost in the world, named Narada and Parvata.

sa: तेभ्यः पितेव पुत्रेभ्यो राजन् ब्रूहि परं नयम्। ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च त्वया नित्यमुपासिताः॥
en: Like a father to his sons do you, therefore, O king, describe to them high morality. You have always adored the Rishis and the gods.

sa: जित्वा संग्रामान्पालयित्वा च राष्ट्र सोमं पीत्वा वर्धयित्वा प्रजाश्च। युक्त्या दण्डं धारयित्वा प्रजानांयुद्धे क्षीणो मोदते देवलोके॥
en: By gaining battles, protecting his kingdom, drinking the Soma juice, making his subjects prosper, holding judiciously the rod of chastisement, and renouncing his body at last in fight, a king enjoy happiness in heaven.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा किल पृथा विसृज्योपययौ गृहान्॥ सोऽर्जुनेन हतो वीरो भ्रात्रा भ्राता सहोदरः।
en: Having said these words, Pritha took his leave and returned to her residence. That hero has been killed by Arjuna,-the uterine brother by the brother.

sa: कश्यपश्च महातेजा ये चान्ये लोककीर्तिताः। तस्मै ब्रह्मा ददौ प्रीतो बलिनो वातरंहसः॥ कामवीर्यधरान् सिद्धान् महापरिषदान् प्रभुः।
en: The lord Brahman then, with a pleased heart, gave to Skanda four powerful companions, gifted with speed of the wind, crowned with ascetic success and gifted with energy which they could increase at will.

sa: अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो यो ददाति महीपते। स गच्छति परं स्थानं विष्णोः पदमनामयम्॥
en: That person, O king, who gives to all creatures promise of his harmlessness goes to the best of regions, vilz., the blessed one of Vishnu.

sa: रन्तिदेवं च सांकृत्यं मृतं संजय शुश्रुम। सम्यगाराध्य यः शक्राद् वरं लेभे महातपाः॥ अन्नं च नो बहु भवेदतिथींच लभेमहि। श्रद्धा च नो मा व्यगमन्मा च याचिष्म कंचन॥
en: We hear, O Srinjaya, that Sankriti's son Rantideva also met with death. Having practised the severest of penances and worshipped him with great reverence, he obtained these boons from Shakra, having solicited them, saying,-Let us have profuse good and innumerable guests! Let not my faith suffer any deterioration, and let us not have to beg anything of any person!

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्मान्नदीगतां चापि ह्युदपानं यशस्विनः। त्रितस्य च महाराज जगामाथ हलायुधः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Baladeva proceeded next to the tirtha Udapana in the Sarasvati, that had formerly been the habitation, O king, of the illustrious ascetic Trita.

sa: तथैवः क्रोधसंरक्तो भीमः परबलार्दनः॥ पुनरेवाब्रवीद् वाक्यं यत् तच्छृणु नराधिप येऽस्मान् पुरोपनृत्यन्त मूढा गौरिति गौरिति॥ तान् वयं प्रतिनृत्यामः पुनर्गौरिति गौरिति। नास्माकं निकृतिर्वह्नि क्षयूतं न वञ्चना। स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य प्रबाधामो वयं रिपून्॥ सोऽवाप्य वैरस्य परस्य पारं वृकोदरः प्राह शनैः प्रहस्या युधिष्ठिरं केशवसंजयांश्च धनंजयं माद्रवतीसुतौ च॥
en: With eyes reddened in wrath, Bhimascna, that grinder of hostile armies, once more said these words. Listen to thein, O king, we will now dance and call them Cows!-who formerly insulted us by calling us so. We have no deceipt, no fire, no match at dice, no deception! Depending upon the strength of our own arins we our resist and check foes!-Having brought those fierce hostilities to a close, Vrikodara once more slowly and laughingly said these words unto Yudhisthira and Keshava and the Shrinjayas and Dhananjaya and the two sons of Madri.

sa: कच्छपी सुखशब्दां तां गृह्य वीणां मनोरमाम्॥ नृत्ये गीते च कुशलो देवब्राह्मणपूजितः।
en: Accomplishment in song and dance and worshipped of gods and Brahmanas, he had with him a beautiful Vina of sweet notes, made of the tortoise-shell.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच शरतल्पे शयानस्तु भरतानां पितामहः। कथमुत्सृष्टवान् देहं कं च योगमधारयत्॥
en: How did the grandfather of Bharatas, who lay on a bed of arrows, cast off his body and what sort of Yoga did he adopt?

sa: कृते प्रतिकृतं पश्य हतपुत्रा हि पाण्डवाः। सौप्तिके शिविरं तेषां हतं सनरवाहनम्॥
en: Mark the vengeance taken for their offense. The Pandavas are now childless. While asleep, the men and animals in their camp have all been killed.

sa: ते शरा मद्रराजेन प्रेषिता रणमूर्धनि। समपतन्तः स्म दृश्यन्ते शलभानां व्रजा इव॥
en: Indeed, those arrows, discharged by the king of the Madras from the rear of the battle, were seen to fall like a flight of birds.

sa: स एव धर्मः सोऽधर्मो देशकाले प्रतिष्ठितः। आदानमनृतं हिंसा धर्मो ह्यावस्थिकः स्मृतः॥
en: Virtue again, according to time and place, becomes sin. Thus misappropriation of another's property, untruth, and injury and killing, may under special circumstances, become virtue.

sa: अधीध्वं वायसी विद्यां शंसन्ति मम वायसाः। अनागतमतीतं च यच्च सम्प्रति वर्तते॥
en: men And he spoke to all the and said,-Study ye the practice of crows! The crows tell me the present, the past, and the future!

sa: महर्षीणां मतं ज्ञात्वा ततः सा सरितां वरा॥ अरुणामानयामास स्वां तनूं पुरुषर्षभ।
en: Understanding the wishes of those great Rishis, that best of rivers caused her body, O foremost of men, to assume a new forn called Arjuna.

sa: तं दीनमनसं वीरं शोकोपहतमातुरम्। निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागं पर्यश्रुनयनं तथा॥ कुन्ती शोकपरीताङ्गी दुःखोपहतचेतना। अब्रवीन्मधुराभाषा काले वचनमर्थवत्॥
en: Seeing that hero cheerless and unnerved by grief, sighing like a snake and shedding profuse tears, Kunti, herself filled with grief and almost beside herself with sorrow, addressed him in these sweet but weighty

sa: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच नाविश्वासाद् विन्दतेऽर्थानीहते चापि किंचन। भयात् त्वेकतरान्नित्यं मृतकल्पा भवन्ति च॥
en: No man can secure the fruitfulness of any object by distrusting others. By cherishing fear one always is compelleu to live as a dead person.

sa: एकस्य तु प्रसादेन कृत्स्नो लोकः प्रसीदति। व्याकुले चाकुलः सर्वो भवतीति विनिश्चयः॥
en: Why is it that one man becomes cheerful, the whole world is cheerful and if that one man is sorry the whole world is sorry?

sa: दृष्ट्वा तं क्रूरमायान्तं जीवितार्थी नराधिप। प्रोवाच श्वा मुनिं तत्र तच्छृणुष्व विशाम्पते॥
en: Seeing that dreadful animal coming, O king, the dog, in fear of his life, spoke to the ascetic as follows. Listen to them, O king!-

sa: माता तु तस्याः कौन्तेय दुहिने स्वं चकं ददौ। तस्याश्चरुमथाज्ञानादात्मसंस्थं चकार ह॥
en: The queen-mother, O son of Kunti, gave the portion reserved for herself to her daughter, and herself took unwittingly the portion intended for the latter.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु गान्धारी युधिष्ठिरमपृच्छत। व स राजेति सक्रोधा पुत्रपौत्रवधार्दिता॥
en: Vaishampayana continued Having said so, Gandhari, filled with anger at the slaughter of all her sons and grandsons enquired after Yudhishthira, saying.-'Where is the king?'

sa: सा पुनः क्षत्रियशतैः पृथिवी सर्वतः स्तृता॥ परावसोर्वचः श्रुत्वा शस्त्रं जग्राह भार्गवः।
en: Hearing these words of Paravashu, the descendant of Bhrigu, once more took up arms and once more covered the Earth with hundreds of Kshatriya bodies.

sa: प्रतिपद्य कुरुक्षेत्रं भीष्ममासाद्य चानघ। सुखां न रजनी पृष्ट्वा गाङ्गेयं रथिनां वरम्॥
en: Proceeding to the field of Kuru and approaching the sinless Bhishma, they enquired of that best of car-warriors if he had spent the night happily.

sa: विमलोदा भगवती ब्रह्मणा यजता पुनः॥ समाहूता ययौ तत्र पुण्ये हैमवते गिरौ।
en: Once again, while Brahınan was engaged in a sacrifice on the sacred forest of the Himavat mountains, the worshipful Sarasvati, summoned by him, came there.

sa: कुभार्यां च कुपुत्रं च कुराजानं कुसौहृदम्। कुसम्बन्धं कुदेशं च दूरतः परिवर्जयेत्॥
en: One should from a distance renounce a bad wife, a bad son, a bad king, a bad friend, a bad allie and a bad country.

sa: उच्यमानस्तु यः श्रेयो गृहीते नो हिताहिते। आपदः समनुप्राप्य स शोचत्यनये स्थितः॥
en: That man, however, who, though advised by his well-wishers, does not follow their words, suffers miseries and is obliged to grieve for his evil policy.

sa: पितॄन् दश तु मातैका सर्वा वा पृथिवीमपि॥ गुरुत्वेनाभिभवति नास्ति मातृसमो गुरुः।
en: The mother, again, is superior to ten fathers, or, perhaps, the whole world, there is no one so much worthy of reverence as the mother.

sa: युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो नैनं शोचितुमर्हसि। जहि शोकं महाप्राज्ञ शृणु चेदं वचो मम॥
en: O mighty-armed Yudhishthira, you should not give way to sorrow thus! O you of at wisdom, destroy this grief and listen to what I say.

sa: समेते सर्वतः स्फीते मुनीनां मण्डले तदा। उत्तरे कोसलाभागे पुण्ये राजन् महात्मनः॥
en: A number of ascetics were also assembled there. It was in the sacred north Koshala, O kir that sacrifice of the great Ouddalaka was celebrated.

sa: ततः स भीमं च धनंजयं च मायाश्च पुत्रौ पुरुषप्रवीरौ। पस्पर्श गात्रैः प्ररुदन् सुगात्रानाश्वास्य कल्याणमुवाच चैतान्॥
en: Having said so, the old king them embraced those beautiful princes, viz., Bhima and Dhananjaya and those tow foremost of men, viz., the two sons of Madri and wept, and comforted and blessed them.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच ततः सत्यवती पुत्रं जनयामास भार्गवम्। तपस्यभिरतं शान्तं जमदग्निं यतव्रतम्॥
en: Vasudeva said, Then Satyavati gave birth to a son in Bhrigu's race who was devoted to penances and peaceful occupations, viz., Jamadagni of regulated vows.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच हतेषु सर्वसैन्येषु सौप्तिके तै स्थैस्त्रिभिः। शोचन् युधिष्ठिरो राजा दाशार्हमिदब्रवीत्॥ कथं नु कृष्ण पापेन क्षुद्रेणाकृतकर्मणा। द्रौणिना निहताः सर्वे मम पुत्रा महारथाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said "After all the soldiers had been killed during the hour of sleep by those three carwarriors, king Yudhishthira sorrowfully said to Krishna:-'How, O Krishna, could my sons, all of whom were great car-warriors, be killed by the sinful and wretched Ashvatthaman who is not an expert in battle?

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्ध भीरूणां भयवर्धनम्। तावकानां परेषां च मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: Then took place on encounter filling the coward with fear, between your soldiers and the enemy, both of whom were bent upon meeting with death.

sa: भीष्म उवाच प्रविश्य स महारण्यं तापसानामथाश्रमम्। आससाद ततो राजा श्रान्तचोपाविशत् तदा।॥
en: Bhishma said Having entered that large forest, the king arrived at an asylum of ascetics. Worn out with toil, he sat himself down for rest.

sa: कालो नूनं महाराज लोकेऽस्मिन् बलवत्तरः। पश्यामो निहतं त्वां च भीमसेनेन संयुगे॥
en: Forsooth, O king, time in this world is more powerful than every thing else, for we see even you struck down by Bhimasena in battle.

sa: सोऽहमद्य महादेवं प्रपद्ये शरणं विभुम्॥ दैवदण्डमिमं घोरं स हि मे नाशयिष्यति।
en: I shall, therefore, at this hour, seek the protection of the powerful Mahadeva. He will remove this dreadful rod of divine punishment uplifted before me.

sa: तदिदं दुष्प्रणीतेन भयं मां समुपस्थितम्॥ न हि द्रोणसुतः संख्ये निवर्तेत कथंचन।
en: For the wickedness of my attempt, this great calamity has befallen me, otherwise Drona's son would never had been compelled to hold back from battle.

sa: अनेकरूपाकृतिभिर्हि बाणै महारथानीकमानुप्रविश्य। स एव एवैकस्तव पुत्रस्य सेनां जघान दैत्यानिव वज्रपाणिः॥
en: Like Indra, the wilder of thunderbolt, striking down the Daityas, Arjuna, alone entering that division of great car-warriors, destroyed it with arrows of various froms.

sa: प्रजा जागर्ति लोकेऽस्मिन् दण्डो जागर्ति तासु च। सर्वं संक्षिपते दण्डः पितामहसमप्रभः॥
en: Creatures are kept awake in this world, and Punishment is awake is among them. Effulgent like the Grandfather himself, Punishment keeps together and maintains everything.

sa: न युद्धधर्माच्छेयान् वै पन्था राजेन्द्र विद्यते। यं समाश्रित्य युद्ध्यन्ते क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ॥
en: There is no path, O monarch, that is better than the duty of battle, Taking recourse to that path, Kshatriyas, O best of Kshatriyas, fight.

sa: स तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा भृशमार्तरूपो युधिष्ठिरो धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः। उच्चैः प्रचुक्रोश च कौरवाश्य: पपात चोर्ध्या सगणो विसंज्ञः॥
en: Seeing them in that condition, Yudhishthira, that best of pious men, become deeply afflicted. That Kuru chief then began to weep aloud and dropped down on the Earth, senseless along with all his followers."

sa: तमब्रवीत् पिता नास्ति त्वदन्यः पुरुषोऽग्रजः। स्थाणुरेष जले मग्नो विस्रब्धः कुरु वैकृतम्॥
en: His father replied, saying,—There is no other born before you! Shiva has pledged himself into the water! Go and create living creatures, without any fear.

sa: अर्धं त्यक्त्वा यदा राजा नीत्यर्धमनुवर्तते। ततस्तु द्वापरं नाम स कालः सम्प्रवर्तते॥
en: When the king follows the great science by only a half, leaving out the other half, then the age that sets in is called Dvapara.

sa: स्त्रियास्तथापचारिण्या निष्कृतिः स्याददूषिका। अपि सा पूयते तेन न तु भर्ता प्रदुष्यति॥
en: By forsaking an unchaste wife one does not incur sin. By such treatment the woman herself may be purified while the husband may avoid sin.

sa: तेषां तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा चाराणां भरतर्षभ। चिन्तामभ्यगमत् तीव्र निःशश्वास च पार्थिवः॥
en: Hearing those words of the messengers who had come back. back. ( Bharata-chief, king Yudhishthira was stricken with great anxiety and began to sigh heavily.
