sa: साधारणं द्वयं ह्येतद् दैवमुत्थानमेव च। पौरुषं हि परं मन्ये दैवं निश्चितमुच्यते॥
en: These two, viz., exertion and destiny, are equal. Of them, I consider exertion to be superior for destiny is determined from the results of exertion.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत: कुन्तीसुतो राजा गतमन्युर्गतज्वरः। काञ्चने प्राङ्मुखो हृष्टो न्यषीदत् परमासने॥
en: Vaishampayana said Shorn of grief and anxiety the royal son of Kunti, took his seat, with face eastwards, on an excellent seat made of gold.

sa: त्वं हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं ससुरासुरमानवान्॥ मर्त्यधर्माण इह तु किमु सृञ्जयसोमकान्।
en: You are capable of vanquishing in battle the three worlds consisting of the gods and Asuras, what to speak of the Somakas and the Shrinjayas."

sa: एवं चाधार्मिकाः पापाः पञ्चाला भिन्नसेतवः। तानेवं भिन्नमर्यादान् किं भवान् न निगर्हति॥
en: The unrighteous and sinful Panchalas, who have trumpeted virtue, are even such. Why do you not blame them who have transgressed the law of virtue.

sa: ततो वागमरैरुक्ता ज्यां तस्य धनुषोऽच्छिनत्। आ तत् सहसा राजंश्छिन्नज्यं व्यस्फुरद् धनुः॥
en: The celestials then cried aloud. At their command, the string of the bow broke. The string having broken, the bow became straight as a line.

sa: एतच कदनं कृत्वा शत्रूणामपकारिणाम्॥ दह्यते स दिवा रात्रौ न च शर्माधिगच्छति।
en: Having caused this destruction of foes that wronged him so, he is burning day and night in grief and does and enjoy peace of mind.

sa: काक्षमाणाः श्रियं कृत्स्नां पृथिव्यां च महद् यशः। कृतान्तविधिसंयुक्ताः कालेन निधनं गताः॥
en: Pursuing great prosperity and fame on Earth, those foremost of men, all of whom were liable to death, have died through the influence of Time.

sa: यद् वयं सुहृदो हत्वा कृत्वा पापमनन्तकम्। नरके निपतिष्यामो ह्यधःशिरस एव ह॥
en: Having killed our kinsmen and friends and thereby committed a sin which cannot be expiated, we shall have tù fall into hell with heads downwards.

sa: ये च संग्रामभूमिष्ठा याचमानाः पराङ्मुखाः। शस्त्रेण निधनं प्राप्ता गतास्ते गुह्यकान् प्रति॥
en: Those warriors that have been killed by weapons, while turning away from the field of begging for quarter, have reached the region of the Guhyakas.

sa: एवं तु श्रुतमस्माभिर्देवलोके महाव्रते॥ तपः परमकं प्राप्तं न तु लोकास्त्वया जिताः।
en: O you of great vows, we have heard this in heaven. Great has been your ascetic merit, but you have no claim to blissful regions.

sa: इत्येवमातः परिदेवयन् स राजा कुरूणां नकुलं बभाषे। गच्छानयनामिह मन्दभाग्यां समातृपक्षामिति राजपुत्रीम्॥
en: Bewailing thus with sorrow, that king of Kuru's race, then addressed Nakula, saying,-'Go and bring the helpless princess Draupadi here with all her maternal relations.'

sa: एतत् सर्वं तु विज्ञाय ह्यात्मदोषकृतं फलम्॥ असूयां पाण्डुपुत्रेषु न भवान् कर्तुमर्हति।
en: Knowing all this to be the fruit of you own folly, it is proper for you not to entertain any ill felling towards the Pandavas.

sa: यथा हि पुरुषश्छिद्याद् वृक्षं परशुना वने। छेत्तुरेव भवेत् पाएं परशोर्न कथञ्चन॥
en: If a person cuts down by an axe a tree in the forest, it is the person that commits the sin and not the axe.

sa: स चेन्निकृत्या युद्ध्येत निकृत्या प्रतियोधयेत्। अथ चेद् धर्मतो युद्ध्येद् धर्मेणैव निवारयेत्॥
en: If the enemy fights deceitfully, he should be paid in his own coin. If, however, he fights fairly, he should be resisted with fair means.

sa: त्वं पुन: सूर्यसंकाशः श्वोभूत उदिते रवौ। प्रकाशे सर्वभूतानां विजेता युधि शात्रवान्॥
en: When the sun rises next morning and light shall clear up all things, you, like a second effulgent sun will vanquish the foe in battle.

sa: तस्मान्नित्यं दया कार्या चातुर्वर्ये विपश्चिता। धर्मात्मा सत्यवाक् चैव राजा रञ्जयति प्रजाः॥
en: Therefore, a wise king should always show mercy towards the four orders of his subjects. The righteous and truthful king succeeds in pleasing his subjects.

sa: कृष्णाजिनं ततो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मण्याय ददौ प्रभुः॥ समरेषु जयं चैव प्रददौ लोकभावनः।
en: The lord Brahma gave him, his devout devotee, a black deer-skin. And the Creator of all the worlds also gave him Victory in all battles.

sa: तस्मान्यान्यश्च पूज्यश्च ब्राह्मणः प्रसृतागभुक्। सर्वं श्रेष्ठं विशिष्टं च निवेद्यं तस्य धर्मतः॥
en: A king, however powerful, powerful, should according to the injunctions of the scriptures confer upon the Brahmana whatever is best and superior to all others,

sa: सानुनीता बहुविधं पर्वतेन महात्मना। शापदोषं च तं भर्तुः श्रुत्वा प्रकृतिमागता॥ पर्वतोऽथ ययौ स्वर्ग नारदोऽभ्यगमद् गृहान्।
en: Assured in various ways be the great Parvata and informed also of the curse on her husband the princess regained the calmness of men. Then Parvata proceeded to heaven and Narada to his home.'

sa: इत्युक्त्वा चरणाभ्यां नेत्रे नृपसुतस्य सा। भित्त्वा स्वस्था तत इदं पूजनी वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ इच्छयेह कृतं पापं सद्यस्तं चोपसर्पति। कृतं प्रतिकृतं येषां न नश्यति शुभाशुभम्॥
en: Having said these words aside, Pujani, with her talons, pierced the eyes of the prince, and finding some comfort from that act of vengeance, once more said,-A sinful deed, committed with deliberation, assails the doer without any loss of time. They, however, who avenge an injury, never lose their merit.

sa: वनमेव गमिष्यामि वसानो मृगचर्मणी। न हि मे निर्जनस्यास्ति जीवितेऽद्य स्पृहा विभो॥
en: As for myself, clad in deer-skins, I shall go to the forest. Friendless, as I am, I have no desire, O king, for even life.

sa: स्वसुतं चाप्यजिघ्रत् तं मूर्ध्नि प्रेम्णा द्विजोत्तमः। परिष्वज्यं चिरं कालं तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: That best of Brahmanas then out of affection smelt the head of his son and embraced him closely, O best of Bharata, for some time.

sa: ततस्तदस्तत्रंन मनसः प्रणष्टं यद् भार्गवोऽस्मै प्रददौ महात्मा। चत्रम्च वामं असते भूमिरस्य प्राप्ते तस्मिन् वधकाले नृवीर॥
en: Really, O King, when the hour of Karna's death approached he forgot the great Brahma weapon which Bhargava had given him. And the Earth was about to devour the left wheel of his car.

sa: विचेष्टमानं मह्यां च सुभृशं गाढवेदनम्॥ तं शयानं तथा दृष्ट्वा भूमौ सुरुधिरोक्षितम्।
en: With great difficulty the king was keeping off those beasts of prey that waited there for feasting upon the body. He was suffering great pain.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्यापि चेद् राजन् क्षत्रधर्मेण वर्ततः। प्रशस्तं जीवितं लोके क्षत्रं हि ब्रह्मसम्भवम्॥
en: The life of even a Brahmana, O king, who follows the observances of a Kshatriya, is not blameable, for Kshatriyas also have originated from Brahman.

sa: ग्रामो धान्यैर्यथा शून्यो यथा कूपश्च निर्जलः। यथा हुतमनग्नौ च तथैव स्यान्निराकृतौ॥
en: As grain without kernel, as a well without water, as libations poured on ashes, even so is a gift to a Brahmana who is ignorant.

sa: यो न यानं न पर्यत न पीठं न गजं रथम्। आरोहेत् सम्मतोऽस्मीति स राजवसतिं वसेत्॥
en: He alone can live in a royal residence who does not, with the confidence that he is a favorite, make use of the king's car, vehicle, or bedstead, or seat, or elephant or chariot.

sa: धर्मपाशनिबद्धेन यन्मया मर्षितं पुरा। तस्य राधेय कोपस्यं विजयं पश्य मे मृधे॥
en: Being bound by the noose of piety, I desisted, before, from taking revenge. Do you now see the result of my restrained anger in battle.

sa: शनैः स तु भवान् यातु ब्रह्मवध्यामनुस्मरन्। न दृश्यते रविस्तात न दिशो न च खं खग॥
en: You please go a little slowly, remembering that you may be responsible for slaying a Brahmana; the sun is invisible, my friend, and cardinal points as also the sky, O you wanderer of heavens.

sa: पितामहं शान्तनवं धृतराष्ट्रं च संजय। द्रोणं कृपं च कर्णं च महाराजं च बाह्निकम्॥ द्रौणिं च सोमदत्तं च शकुनि चापि सौबलम्। दुःशासनं शलं चैव पुरुमित्रं विविंशतिम्॥ विकर्ण चित्रसेनं च जयत्सेनं च पार्थिवम्। विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ दुर्मुखं चापि कौरवम्॥ सैन्धव दुःसहं चैव भूरिश्रवसमेव च। भगदत्तं च राजानं जलसन्धं च पार्थिवम्॥ ये चाप्यन्ये पार्थिवास्तत्र योद्धं समागताः कौरवाणां प्रियार्थम्। मुमूर्षवः पाण्डवाग्नौ प्रदीप्ते समानीता धार्तराष्ट्रण होतुम्॥
en: Our grand-father, the son of Shantanu and Dhritarashtra too, O Sanjaya and Drona and Kripa and Karna and the Balhika and the son of Drona and Somadatta and Shakuni and the son of Subala and Dushasana and Shala and Purumitra and Vivingshati and Vikarna and Chitrasena and the ruler of the earth Jayatsena and the two chiefs of Avanti, Vindu and Anuvindu and the Kaurava Durmukha and the king of Sindhu and Dusaha and Bhurishravas and the king Bhagadatta and the ruler of the earth Jarasandha and the other rulers of the earth, who have assembled to fight on that side in the interests of the sons of Kuru, are about to die. They have been brought together by the son of Dhritarashtra as offerings for the blazing fire of the sons of Pandu.

sa: यः पुनः प्रतिमानेन त्रीनल्लोकानतिरिच्यते। तं कृष्णं पुण्डरीकाक्षं को नु युद्ध्येत बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Then again, he who in measure of strength surpasses the three worlds, what intelligent man would fight with that Krishna, whose eyes are like lotuses.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततोऽस्याकथयद् राजा दुर्योधनसमागमम्। तच्च शुश्रूषितं सर्वं वरदानं च भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then, O descendant of Bharata, did the king (Shalya) tell (the Pandavas) all about his meeting with Duryodhana, his promise and his boon.

sa: विदितं हि तवात्यन्तं क्रुद्धाविव यमान्तकौ। भीमार्जुनौ नयेतां हि देवानपि परां गतिम्॥
en: It is known to you that the two, Bhima and Arjuna when excited with wrath would even lead the very gods to obtain eternal salvation.

sa: अथाब्रवीद् राजपुत्री कौरव्यो महिषीं प्रियाम्। गच्छ सैरन्ध्र मात्र स्थाः सुदेष्णाया निवेशनम्॥
en: Then the chief of the Kurus addressed the princess, his beloved consort, saying "O Sairandhri, do not stay here, go to the apartment of Sudeshna.

sa: नारद उवाच एतत् तु नागलोकस्य नाभिस्थाने स्थितं पुरम्। पातालमिति विख्यातं दैत्यदानवसेवितम्॥
en: Narada said This city, situated in the very heart of the region of the Nagas, is known as Patalam, inhabited by the Daityas and Danavas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अभिवाद्याथ तां कृष्णः कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। निश्चक्राम महाबाहुः सिंहखेलगतिस्ततः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Krishna, with long arms, then having saluted her and having gone round her, departed from there with the gait of a sportive lion.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच श्रूयते भगवन् दूतास्तवागच्छन्ति मानवान्। नेतुं किल भवान् कस्मादागतोऽसि स्वयं प्रभो॥
en: Savitri said: We hear, O god, that your emissaries come to take away men. How is it that your worshipful self has come in person?

sa: पप्रच्छ रामस्तं वाग्मी कस्त्वं प्रब्रूहि पृच्छतः। कामया किमिदं चित्रमाश्चर्यं प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: Then the eloquent Rama asked him "tell me who you are. How did such a thing come about? All this appears to me highly marvellous.”

sa: तमहं कुपिता भीम पुनः कोपं नियम्य च। अब्रुवं कामसम्मूढमात्मानं रक्ष कीचक॥ गन्धर्वाणमहं भार्या पञ्चानां महिषी प्रिया। ते त्वां निहन्युः कुपिताः शूराः साहसकारिणः॥
en: O Bhima, getting enraged with him and then again suppressing my anger I said to Kichaka, rendered senseless by lust in the following words)-0Kichaka save yourself; I am the dear queen and wife of five Gandharvas; those heroes if enraged will kill you who are going to act so rashly.”

sa: योऽयं काञ्चनसंनाहः पाणिं वहति शोभन:। समं शैब्यस्य तं मन्ये जवेन बलवत्तरम्॥
en: The beautiful horse, clad in golden mail, that draws the car by the rear pole, is equal to Shaivya in speed but superior in strength.

sa: विविशुस्ते स्म कौरव्या वृता विप्रर्षभैस्तदा। तद् वनं भरतश्रेष्ठाः स्वर्ग सुकृतिनो यथा॥
en: As virtuous men enter the celestials regions, those foremost of the Bharata race, those descendants of Kuru, surrounded by the excellent Brahmanas, entered that forest.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच अथ भार्यासहायः स फलान्यादाय वीर्यवान्। कठिनं पूरयामास ततः काष्ठान्यपाटयत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Accompanied by his wife the powerful Satyavana (first) gathered fruits and filled his bag; he then began to cut down the trees.

sa: आशीविषं घोरतरं पादेन स्पृशतीह कः। सिंह केसरिणं कश्च दंष्ट्रायां स्पृश्य तिष्ठति॥
en: Who is he that has trodden over a terrible snake? Who is he that has thrust his hand into the jaws of a mained lion?"

sa: किमिहागमने चापि कार्यं ते राक्षसेश्वर। कृतमित्येव तद् विद्धि यद्यपि स्यात् सुदुष्करम्॥
en: O lord of the Rakshasas, what business has brought you here? Know it to be already performed even if it be very difficult of fulfillment."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा तौ कथयित्वा तु वाष्पमुत्सृज्य दुःखितौ। रात्रिशेषं तमत्युग्रं धारयामासतुर्हदि॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having thus held their mutual conversation, and shedding tears in grief, they both awaited the dawn of that night with an anxious heart.

sa: त्राहि राजनिमं लोकं न नश्येयुरिमा: प्रजाः। त्वयि प्रकृतिमापन्ने शेष: स्यात् कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Rescue, O king, the world; do not destroy these creatures; yourself regaining your natural disposition all this will end, O delighted of the Kuru race.

sa: उपतिष्ठतु देवी पामेतदस्या हितं परम्। युष्याकं च सदा देवाः शिवमेवं भविष्यति॥
en: Let the goddess attend on me; this will be of great benefit to her and it will also prove to be your means of safety.

sa: नगरे प्रतिरुद्धः सन् बहिरे बुभुक्षितः। अमित्रान् भूयसः पश्येद् यः साक्ष्यमनृतं वदेत्॥
en: The man, who is giving evidence tells lies, stays staving at the outer gates, shut out from the city; and he always sees his enemies.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच रुद्राणां वा वसूनां वा मरुतां वा प्रधानभाक्। पृच्छामि को भवान् देवो नैतच्छकुनिना कृतम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said : Are you the foremost of the Rudras or the Vasus or the Marutas? I ask you what god you are. It is not possible for a bird to have done this.

sa: नन्वहं कृष्ण भीष्मस्य धृतराष्ट्रस्य चोभयोः। स्नुषा भवामि धर्मेण साहं सादीकृता बलात्॥
en: I am, morally speaking, O Krishna, the daughter-in-law of both Bhishma and Dhritarashtra; and yet I, who am such, was made a slave by force.

sa: अत्र पूर्वं वसिष्ठस्य पौराणस्य द्विजर्षभ। सूतिश्चैव प्रतिष्ठा च निधनं च प्रकाशते॥
en: Here, in days of old, O best among the twice born, took place the birth, attainment to fame and death of the ancient Rishi Vasishtha.

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः यथास्य भार्या सावित्री सर्वैरेव सुलक्षणैः। अवैधव्यकरैर्युक्ता तथा जीवति सत्यवान्॥
en: The Rishis said : As his wife Savitri bears all the auspicious signs indicative of her exemption from widowhood, it is certain that Satyavana lives.

sa: आर्यक उवाच न मे नमैतद् बहुमतं महर्षे वचनं तव। सखा शक्रस्य संयुक्तः कस्यायं नेप्सितो भवेत्॥
en: These words of yours, O great Rishi, are not approved of by me. The cause is not want of respect for you; foe who would not desire a connection with the friend of Shaka?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच संजयाचक्ष्व येनास्मान् पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत। धृष्टद्युम्नस्य सैन्येन सोमकानां बलेन च॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, tell us about those with whose aid that Pandu king will high, viz., the army of Dhrishtadyumna and of the Somakas.

sa: सत्कृताश्च कृतार्थाश्च मित्राणां न भवन्ति ये। तान् मृतानपि क्रव्यादाः कृतघ्नान् नोपभुञ्जते॥
en: The dead bodies of those, who, served and benefited by friends, show them ingratitude, are eaten up with disgust even by the birds of prey.

sa: चतुर्वर्षशतायुर्मे भर्ता लब्धश्च सत्यवान्। भर्तुर्हि जीवितार्थं तु मया चीर्णं त्विदं व्रतम्॥
en: (Again) my husband Satyavana has been blessed with a life of four hundred years. I observed the vow for the sake of my husband's life.

sa: सोऽहं पक्षैकदेशेन वहामि त्वां गतक्लमः। विमृशं त्वं शनैस्तात को न्वत्र बलवानिति॥
en: I bear you who are such on one portion of my wings without experiencing any fatigue. Think, O dear as to who is the stronger.

sa: यथाकामं च गच्छेयमागच्छेयं तथैव च। शय्यासने च मे राजन् नापराध्येत कश्चन॥
en: I will go out and come in at my pleasure. And O king, with regard to my food or bed no body shall disturb me."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अयं राजन् ब्रवीम्येतत् तस्य गुह्यं विभावसोः। यादृशे कुण्डले ते च कवचं चैव यादृशम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, I am now relating to you the secret of the god having his rays for wealth and also of what sort the armour and the pair of earrings were.

sa: ततो वृद्धान् द्विजान् सर्वानृत्विजः सपुरोहितान्। समाहूय दिने पुण्ये प्रययौ सह कन्यया॥
en: Then, inviting all the old Brahmanas and the Ritvijas together with the priests, the king accompanied by his daughter set out on an auspicious day.

sa: परित्यज्य प्रियान् प्राणान् धनार्थं हि महामते। प्रविशन्ति नरा वीराः समुद्रमटवीं तथा॥
en: O high-minded one, even abandoning (the hope of) dear life itself, heroic men enter into the depths of the sea and the forest for wealth.

sa: संशये तु महत्यस्मिन् किं नु मे क्षममुत्तरम्। विनाशं ह्येव पश्यामि कुरूणामनुचिन्यन्॥
en: I have grave doubts that I shall have any prosperity in the future; thinking thus I see (in my mind) the destruction of the Kurus.

sa: न त्वेवोत्सादनीया मे पाण्डोः पुत्रा जनाधिप। तस्माद् योधान् हनिष्यामि प्रयोगेणायुतं सदा॥
en: But these sons of Pandu ought not to be slain by me, O ruler of men; therefore shall I slay ten thousand warriors every day.

sa: नाचरं वृजिनं किंचिद् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य नित्यशः। अहं हि पाण्डवान् सर्वान् हनिष्यामि रणेस्थितान्॥
en: I have never been without the slightest injury towards the son of Dhritarashtra and I shall kill all the sons of Pandu, engaged in battle.

sa: पदा मूर्ध्नि महाबाहुः प्राहरद् विलपिष्यतः। तस्य जानुं ददौ भीमो जने चैनमरलिना।
en: The mighty-armed (Bhima) struck him on the head, who was weeping, with his foot and placing his keen on his breast dealt him severe blows.

sa: स्वमर्थं यः परित्यज्य परार्थमनुतिष्ठति। मिथ्या चरति मित्रार्थं यश्च मूढः स उच्यते॥
en: He is said be a fool who neglecting his own interests looks after those of others and who resorts to deceit for (serving) his friends.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमेतन्महाराज यथा वदसि भारत। युद्धे विनाशः क्षत्रस्य गाण्डीवेन प्रदृश्यते॥
en: Sanjaya said It is, O great king, as you say, O Bharata. The destruction of the Kshatriya by war with the Gandiva bow seems apparent.

sa: कुमारवच्च स्मयसे छूते विनिकृतेषु यत्। पाण्डवेषु वने राजन् प्रव्रजत्सु पुनः पुनः॥
en: Like a boy, too, did you repeatedly laugh at the defeat (of the Pandavas) at dice and also when they were wandering about being exiled.

sa: चिकीर्षितं विप्रकृतं च यस्य नान्ये जनाः कर्म जानन्ति किंचित्। मन्त्रे गुप्ते सम्यगनुष्ठिते च नाल्पोऽप्यस्थच्यवते कश्चिदर्थः॥
en: He, whose proposed acts and acts put into execution are seldom known to others and whose intentions are kept secret and put into practice suitably, does not fail in his objects even when trifling.

sa: अमोघा हन्ति शतशः शत्रून् मम करच्युता। पुनश्च पाणितमभ्येति मम दैत्यान् विनिघ्नतः॥
en: This infallible dart, when I am engaged in slaughtering the Daityas, hurled by my hand kills hundreds of enemies and then returns to my hand.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अक्षौहिणी: सप्त लब्ध्वा राजभिः सह संजय। किंस्विदिच्छति कौन्तेयो युद्धप्रेप्सुर्युधिष्ठिरः।।शा
en: Duryodhana said Having obtained an army of seven Akshauhinis, what does Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, desirous of war, do along with the other kings.

sa: आत्मन्यपि न विश्वासस्तथा भवति सत्सु यः। तस्मात् सत्सु विशेषेण सर्वः प्रणयमिच्छति॥
en: People do not place so inuch reliance on their own selves as on the virtuous. Therefore everybody wishes particularly to cultivate intimacy with the righteous.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच अयमस्मि महाबाहो ब्रूहि यत् ते विवक्षितम्। करिष्यामि हि तत् सर्वं यत् त्वं वक्ष्यसि भारत॥
en: The blessed Krishna of divine attributes said Here am I, O you with long arms. Speak what you want to say. I shall do all that you will ask me to do, O Bharata.

sa: शकुनिः सूतपुत्रश्च भ्राता दुःशासनस्तथा। स हि त्यागेन राज्यस्य न शमं समुपैष्यति॥
en: (Who are) Shakuni, the son of Suta (Karna) and his brother Dushasana? He will not effect peace by giving up (any portion of) the kingdom.

sa: इन्द्रोऽप्येतन्नोत्सहेत् तात हर्तु मैश्वर्यं नो जीवति भीमसेने। धनंजये नकुले चैव सूत तथा वीरे सहदेवे सहिष्णौ॥
en: Indra even would not be able to stand against him, for robbing us of our wealth, during the life time of Bhimasena and Dhananjaya, 0 Suta and the patient Nakula and the hero Sahadeva.

sa: त्वं हि राष्ट्रस्य परमा गतिर्मत्स्यपतेः सुतः। यथा हि पाण्डुपुत्राणामर्जुनो जयतां वरः॥
en: You are the greatest support of the kingdom, the son of Matsya king, like Arjuna, the foremost of the victors amongst the sons of Pandu.

sa: पृथक् काञ्चनसंनाहान् रथेष्वश्वानयोजयन्। सूर्यचन्द्रप्रतीकाशे रथे दिव्ये हिरण्मये॥ महानुभावो मत्स्यस्य ध्वज उच्छिश्रिये तदा। अथान्यान् विविधाकारान् ध्वजान् हेमपरिष्कृतान्।।१९ यथास्वं क्षत्रियाः शूरा रथेषु समयोजयन्। अथ मत्स्योऽब्रवीद् राजा शतानीकं जघन्यजम्॥
en: Then they yoked to their excellent white cars, horses, equipped in mail. Matsya's glorious standard was hoisted on his beautiful car decked with gold and resembling the sun or moon in lustre. Other Kshatriya heroes too hoisted on their own cars golden flags of various forms and contrivances. Then the king of Matsya said to his younger brother Shatanika.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच शृणुध्वं यत् करिष्यामि कर्म वै कुरुनन्दनाः। विराटमनुसम्प्राप्य राजानं पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O you sons of Kuru, O you best among men, listen what work I shall do after having come before the king Virata.

sa: राज्ञः समीपे पुरुषत्तमौ तु यमाविमौ विष्णुमहेन्द्रकल्पौ। मनुष्यलोके सकले समोऽस्ति ययोर्न रूपे न बले न शीले।॥
en: Those two foremost of men, who are near the king, are the twins. They are equal to Vishnu and Mahendra. In this world, there is none equal to them in beauty, strength and accomplishments.

sa: तेषामेव कृतो भागो मालवाः शाल्वकास्तथा। त्रिगर्तानां चैव मुख्यौ यौ तौ संशप्तकाविति॥
en: In their share have also fallen the Malavas, the Shalvakas and the two foremost of the Trigartas, who have resolved to win or to die.

sa: विदीर्येत् सकला भूमियोश्चापि शकलीभवेत्। रविरात्मप्रभा जह्यात् सोमः शीतांशुतां त्येजत्॥ वायुः शैयमथो जह्याद्धिमवांश्च परिव्रजेत्। शुष्येत् तोयं समुद्रेषु वह्निरप्युष्णतां त्येजत्॥ न चाहं त्वदृते राजन् प्रशासेयं वसुन्धराम्। पुनः पुनः प्रसीदेति वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह॥
en: The earth may split, the heavens may fall down in pieces, the sun may lose his rays, the moon may abandon her coolness, the wind may forsake its speed, the Himalayas may be moved from its site, the waters of the ocean may dry up and fire may lose its heat; But, ( king, I cannot rule the earth without you.” He again and again said, “Relent," "Relent".

sa: एवं स सूतपुत्रत्वं जगामामितविक्रमः। वसुषेण इति ख्यातो वृष इत्येव च प्रभुः॥
en: Thus did the boy of immeasurable strength and splendour come to be known as the son of a charioteer and was styled Vasusena and Vrisha.

sa: इत्येतद् वो मयाऽऽख्यातं विहरिष्याम्यहं यथा। वृकोदर विराटे त्वं रंस्यसे केन हेतुना॥
en: I have told you all that-how I would pass my days there. O Vrikodara, in what capacity will you live in the city of Virata?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स्तथार्जुनो धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः। वाक्यं तथासौ विरराम भूयो नृपोऽपरं भ्रातरमाबभाषे॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having spoken thus, Arjuna, the best of men and the foremost of the virtuous, ceased, and the king again asked his another brother.

sa: अयं स्म युद्धे मन्यतेऽन्यैरजेयं तमेकलव्यं नाम निषादराजम्। वेगेनैव शैलमभिहत्य जम्भः शेते स कृष्णेन हतः परासुः॥
en: He was challenged by the king of Nishadas, named Ekalavya, who was incapable of being vanquished by others; but he being struck with force by Krishna lay dead smashed on the hillock like Jambha.

sa: सर्वे च पृथिवीपाला मदर्थं तात पाण्डवान्। आर्याः शस्त्रभृतः शूराः समर्थाः प्रतिबाधितुम्॥
en: All the rulers of the earth, too, leading honourable lives, the heroes capable of wielding weapons can for my sake, O sire, oppose the Pandavas.

sa: यच्चानृत इति ख्यायाद् यः स गच्छेत् पराभवम्। णुयुर्मरणं पार्था नानृतत्वं कथंचन॥
en: Whoever will regard them as dishonest will meet with discomfiture today. The sons of Pritha will rather invite death but will never speak an untruth.

sa: बृहन्नलोवाच व्यवहार्यश्च राजेन्द्र शुचिश्चैव भविष्यसि। धनूंष्येतानि मा भैस्त्वं शरीरं नात्र विद्यते॥
en: Brihannala said You shall remain clean and unpolluted, O foremost of kings. Fear not, there are only bows on this tree and not a corpse.

sa: तदेष ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः सागरान्तिके। अत्र विश्रम्य भुक्त्वा च निवर्तिष्याव गालव॥
en: This is the mountain named Rishava on the limits of the sea; rest yourself here; after making our repast here we shall return, O Galava.

sa: बाह्रीकस्य प्रियो भ्राता शान्तनोश्च महात्मनः। सौभ्रात्रं च परं तेषां सहितानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: He was the dear brother of Balhika and also of the great souled Shantanu; in fact among all those great-souled men excellent brotherly feelings existed.

sa: न हि तां वेद नार्यन्या काचिद् धात्रेयिकामृते। कन्यापुरगतां बालां निपुणां परिरक्षणे॥
en: And as that girl lived in the apartments of maidens, no other women knew her condition except her nurse's daughter who was wellskilled in ministrations.

sa: यदि काक्षन्ति ते राज्यं पितृपैतामहं पुनः। यथाप्रतिज्ञं कालं तं चरन्तु वनमाश्रिताः॥
en: If they want back the kingdom of their forefathers let them, as stipulated, reside in the forest to the end of the period (agreed on).

sa: महावनमिवच्छिन्नं यदा द्रक्ष्यसि पातितम्। बलं कुरूणां भीमेन तदा स्मर्ताऽसि मे वचः॥
en: When you will see the army of the Kurus, felled down by Bhima like a large forest torn off, then will you remember my words.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा भर्तृवचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्री यशस्विनी। अन्विच्छन्ती महच्छ्रेयो गान्धारी वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said That princess, of great renown Gandhari having heard the words of her husband, said these words desiring the greatest good of her son.

sa: न प्रियो मम कृष्णाया बीभत्सुर्न युधिष्ठिरः। भीमसेनो यमौ वापि यदपश्यं सभागताम्॥
en: When I remember Krishna dragged to the Assembly-Hall, Vibhatsu, Yudhishthira, Bhimasena and also the twin brothers, Nakula and Sahadeva cease to be dear to me.

sa: एतौ हि कर्मणा लोकानश्नुवातेऽक्षयान् ध्रुवान्। तत्र तत्रैव जायते युद्धकाले पुनः पुनः॥
en: These two by their acts attain to several eternal and inexhaustible regions and are born in those places again and again in times of war.

sa: मद्वितीयं पुनः पार्थं कः प्रार्थयितुमिच्छति। यो न कालपरीतो वाप्यपि साक्षात् पुरंदरः॥
en: Who would like to challenge the son of Pritha, having me for his second, unless his time were come, even if he were Purandara himself?

sa: सर्वैः पुत्रैः प्रियतरा द्रौपदी मे जनार्दन। कुलीना रूपसप्पन्ना सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः॥
en: O Janardana, Draupadi is dearer to me than all my sons. She comes of a noble family, endued with beauty and endowed with all virtues.

sa: स तावुवाच तेजस्वी सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। गृध्रराजोऽस्मि भद्रं वां सखा दशरथस्य वै॥
en: The spirited (vulture) then said to Rama and Lakshmana. “All hail to you, I am the king of the vultures and a friend of Dasharatha's."

sa: प्रायेण श्रीमतां लोके भोक्तुं शक्तिर्न विद्यते। जीर्यन्त्यपि हि काष्ठानि दरिद्राणां महीपते॥
en: In this, world the opulent mostly have no capacity, for eating, whiled O Lord of the earth, pieces of wood are digested by the poor.

sa: अहापुंश्च वनं यान्तः समूलं हृदयं मम। अतदर्हा महात्मानः कथं केशवं पाण्डवाः॥
en: Have gone to the forest, rendering the very bottom of my heart. These large-souled sons of Pandu undeserving of these miserieshow did they, O Keshava.

sa: नैव मेऽस्ति धनं किंचिन्न धनेनान्वितः सुहृत्। न चार्थेनापि महता शक्यमेतद् व्यपोहितुम्॥
en: I do not possess wealth; nor have I any friend possessed of wealth and even with great wealth this object of mine cannot be gained.

sa: येषु नः प्रत्ययो राजंश्चारेषु मनुजाधिप। ते यान्तु दत्तदेया वै भूयस्तान् परिमार्गितुम्॥
en: O king, O lord of men, let those spies, in whom we have confidence, receive their remuneration in advance and proceed in search of them.

sa: न चोच्छेदं कुलं यायाद् विस्तीर्येच्च कथं यशः। तस्याहमीप्सितं बुद्ध्वा काली मातरमावहम्॥
en: Let my family be not extinct; how can my fame spread?” I coming to know of this desire of his got Kali as my stepmother.

sa: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना द्वितीयः स्यात् कथं सुतः। एकपुत्रमपुत्रं वै प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: A desire rose in his mind "How shall I have a second son, for wise men speak of one son as no son at all.

sa: ततश्चक्षुर्दधे पार्थो यत्र विस्फार्यते धनुः। ददर्श तत्र राधेयं तस्य कोपो व्यवर्धत॥
en: Then Partha looked forward to where from came the twang of the bow and saw the son of Radha, at which his anger was excited.

sa: भार्याभिहर्ता वैरी यो यश्च राज्यहरो रिपुः। याचमानोऽपि संग्रामे न मोक्तव्यः कथंचन॥
en: The enemy who carries away one's wife or wrests his kingdom, should by no means be forgiven in battle even if he craves for mercy.”

sa: यत् तु कारयं महाबाहो मनसा कार्यतां गतम्। सर्वोपायैर्न तच्छक्यं केनचित् कर्तुमन्यथा॥
en: Whatever act, O you with long arms, is fructified in his mind's eye cannot be prevented by any man by every mean in his power.

sa: सरितः सागरं प्राप्य यथा नश्यन्ति सर्वशः। तथैव ते विनक्ष्यन्ति मामासाद्य सहान्वयाः॥
en: I am of superior intelligence, of superior might and of superior prowess. My knowledge is superior and my application and concentration are superior to theirs.

sa: इदं च राज्यं पार्थाय यच्चान्यदपि किञ्चन। प्रतिगृह्णन्तु तत् सर्वं पाण्डवा अविशङ्कया।॥
en: I make a gift of this my kingdom and what else I have, to the sons of Pritha. May they accept it without any hesitation.

sa: अस्त्रेण योधयुग्या च शीघ्रत्वे कौशले तथा। सर्वे स्म समजातीयाः सर्वे मानुषयोनयः॥
en: In weapons, in the science of fighting, in agility and in skill, all are of the same species; all had our birth in human beings.

sa: स हि पूज्यतमो लोके कृष्णः पृथुललोचनः। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां विदितं मम सर्वथा॥
en: Krishna of big eyes is most worthy of worship in this world by all the three worlds. This fact is always present in my mind.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथमिन्द्रेण राजेन्द्र सभार्येण महात्मना। दुःखं प्राप्तं परं घोरमेतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्।।।।
en: Yudhishthira said I want to hear how is was, O chief among, kings, that the large minded Indra, with his queen met with grave difficulties.

sa: उपनह्य परैर्वैरं ये मां नित्यमुपासते। नमस्कुर्वन्ति च सदा वसवो वासवं यथा॥
en: They, who having declared hostilities with others, ever seek to please me and ever bow down before me as the Vasus bow down to Vasava,

sa: उपेयाय स तु क्षिप्रं रथात् प्रस्कन्द्य कुण्डली। प्रविवेश सभां पूर्णां महीपालैर्महात्मभिः॥
en: Coming to that place quickly and dismounting from the chariot the one having earrings entered the Council Chamber full of great-souled rulers of the earth.

sa: यम उवाच शतं सुतानां बलवीर्यशालिनां भविष्यति प्रीतिकरं तवाबले। परिश्रमस्ते न भवेनृपात्मजे निवर्त दूरं हि पथस्त्वमागता॥
en: Yama said : Lady, you shall have one hundred strong and powerful sons who will cause your delight. Princess, do not take any further trouble; go back; indeed you have come a great way.

sa: येन सप्त महाताला गिरिभूमिश्च दारिताः। बाणेनैकेन काकुत्स्थ स्थाता ते को रणाग्रतः।।।।
en: O Kākutstha, who can stand before you in a battle, who has pierced the seven trees, and the mountain, and the earth with one arrow?

sa: व्यक्तमद्य त्वया वीर धर्मतः सम्प्रवर्तता। किष्किन्धेव पुरी रम्या स्वर्गमार्गे विनिर्मिता ॥
en: Evident it is, O hero, that while engaged in a lawful conflict, you hadst created another city of Kiskindha, in the region of the celestials.

sa: न सकामां करिष्यामि स्वामिमां मातृगन्धिनीम्। वने वत्स्याम्यहं दुर्गे रामो राजा भविष्यति॥
en: I will never fulfil the desire of this lady proud of her son. I will inhabit the impracticable woods, and Rāma shall become the monarch.

sa: तं गजाश्च वराहाश्च सिंहा व्याघ्राश्च सर्वतः। अभिगर्जन्ति सततं तेन शब्देन दर्पिताः॥
en: Coming to it, elephants, and boars, and lions, and tigers, on all sides roar ceaselessly, wrought up by the echoes their own cries have produced.

sa: दुधुवे च स रोमाणि चकम्पे चानलोपमः। ननाद च महानादं सुमहानिव तोयदः॥
en: Meanwhile the fire-like mighty hero trembled in his limbs and his hairs stood on their ends, and he roared like the rumbling of a cloud.

sa: पुत्रो विश्रवसः साक्षाद् भ्राता वैश्रवणस्य च। इत्युक्त्वा दुर्लभान् प्राणान् मुमोच पतगेश्वरः॥
en: Thereupon the king of birds gave up his dear life uttering only-Rāvana is the son of Visravā and brother to Vaisravana (the lord of wealth).

sa: माता च मम कौसल्या वृद्धा संतापकर्शिता। धर्ममेवाग्रतः कृत्वा त्वत्तः सम्मानमर्हति ॥
en: My mother Kausalyā is old and much pressed down with sorrow; do you show proper respects to her, considering it to be a pious deed.

sa: सा सीता स्वर्गतं श्रुत्वा श्वशुरं तं महानृपम्। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां न शशाकेक्षितं प्रियम्॥
en: Having heard that her father-in-law, the king, had gone to the celestial regions. Sītā with her eyes filled with tears, could not see her beloved.

sa: दैवतानि च यान्यस्मिन् वने विविधपादपे। नमस्करोम्यहं तेभ्यो भर्तुः शंसत मां हृताम्॥
en: I salute and invoke the deities that live in this forest of many trees to tell my husband of my being stolen away (by Ravana).

sa: कोट्यस्तत्र चतुर्विंशद् गन्धर्वाणां तपस्विनाम्॥ वसन्त्यग्निनिकाशानां घोराणां पापकर्मणाम्। पावकार्चिः प्रतीकाशाः समवेताः समन्ततः॥
en: There dwell all around in a body four and twenty kotis of ascetic Gandharvas, resembling fire, dreadful, practicising impiety, and like to flames of fire.

sa: भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन रावणो नाम राक्षसः। सर्वान् नो बाधते वीर्याच्छासितुं तं न शक्नुमः॥
en: O you possessed of the six attributes, through your grace, a Rākşasa named Rāvaņa oppresses us all by his prowess, nor can we baffle him.

sa: यदवानन्तरं कार्य लोकानां हितकाम्यया। संविधत्स्व विधानज्ञ त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः॥
en: Do you now, O you conversant with resources, so order as is advisable in the interests of the worlds! Verily you are our prime way.'

sa: लाक्षया मधुमांसेन लोहेन च विषेण च। सदैव बिभृयाद् भृत्यान् यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May he that had approved the exile of the noble one into the woods always feed his family with lac, honey, meat, iron, and poison!

sa: आपृच्छे त्वां महाराज सर्वेषामीश्वरोऽसि नः। प्रस्थितं दण्डकारण्यं पश्य त्वं कुशलेन माम्॥
en: I ask you, O mighty monarch, as you are the lord of us all. Do you see me safely despatched to the forest of Dandaka.

sa: स तु तीरं समासाद्य तमसाया मुनिस्तदा। शिष्यमाह स्थितं पार्श्वे दृष्ट्वा तीर्थमकर्दमम्॥
en: And having arrived at the banks of that river, the pious one, observing a holy spot devoid of mud, spoke to his disciple standing by.

sa: अयं युक्तो महाबाहो रथस्ते रथिनां वर। त्वरयारोह भद्रं ते ससीतः सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Here, O mighty-armed one, is your car ready yoked, O foremost of car-warriors. Do you speedily ascend, good betide you, along with Sītā and Laksmaņa.

sa: अनेन सीता वैदेही भक्षति नात्र संशयः। गृध्ररूपमिदं व्यक्तं रक्षो भ्रमति काननम्॥
en: It is clear and beyond all doubt that Vaidehī has been devoured by this Rākşasa, assuming the shape of a vulture and ranging the forest.

sa: तवार्ये सद्गुणैर्युक्तः स पुत्रः पुरुषोत्तमः। किं ते विलपितेनैवं कृपणं रुदितेन वा॥
en: O worshipful one, your son is crowned with all qualities, and is the best of men. Why then do you bewail thus, or weep bitterly?

sa: यदि त्ववश्यं वस्तव्यं कर्तव्यं च पितुर्वचः। अहमेव निवत्स्यामि चतुर्दश वने समाः॥
en: But if he must dwell here, and thus act out the mandate of our father, I also will abide in the forest for fourteen years.

sa: भक्षार्थं जातसंरम्भा गर्जन्ती साभ्यधावत्। आपतन्ती तु तां दृष्ट्वा अगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः॥ राक्षसत्वं भजस्वेति मारीचं व्याजहार सः।
en: And enraged with Agastya, she rushed at him with a roar, intending to devour him. And on seeing her thus rushing, that worshipful saint, Agastya, said to Mārīca, Do you become a Raksasa! .

sa: शुश्रुवे चाग्रतः स्त्रीणां रुदतीनां महास्वनः। यथा नादः करेणूनां बद्धे महति कुञ्जरे।।२९
en: He heard before him a mighty noise proceeding from weeping women, like to the roars of she-elephants, when a great elephant has been taken captive.

sa: तत्र रम्ये वने वासं कृत्वासौ प्राङ्मुखो ययौ। उद्यानमुज्जिहानायाः प्रियका यत्र पादपाः॥
en: Having for a while stayed at that romantic wood, he proceeded eastwards, and presented himself at the villa of Ujjihānāya, where abound trees (called) Priyaka.

sa: सा तदा समलंकृत्य सीता सुरसुतोपमा। प्रणम्य शिरसा पादौ रामं त्वभिमुखी ययौ॥
en: Thereat, having adorned herself, Sītā, resembling the daughter of a celestial, bowing down to the feet (of the female ascetic), directed her steps towards Rāma.

sa: स हि राज्यस्य सर्वस्य सुखमेकं भविष्यति। ताते तु वयसातीते मयि चारण्यमाश्रिते॥
en: Now that our father has grown old and I have taken refuge in the forest, he will alone experience the supreme felicity in the kingdom.

sa: त्वं पुनर्जम्बुक: सिंहीं मामिहेच्छसि दुर्लभाम्। नाहं शक्या त्वया स्प्रष्टुमादित्यस्य प्रभा यथा॥
en: Why do you being a tiger wish for a she-lion? You shall not be able to touch me like to the rays of the sun.

sa: यदहं नोपचारेण ब्रूयां स्नेहादविक्लवम्। भक्तिमानिति तत् तावद् वाक्यं त्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि ॥ कथं हि त्वविहीनोऽहं प्रतियास्यामि तां पुरीम्। तव तात वियोगेन पुत्रशोकातुरामिव ॥
en: It behoves you to forgive what I say plainly from affection, without letting myself by overwhelmed with emotion, and with due reverence for you. How can I, O child, without you return to that city, which seems as it afflicted with the grief incident to the loss of a son?

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा ऋषिमध्ये नराधिपः॥ वाक्यं वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठः प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम्।
en: Hearing his speech in the midst of the saints, that best of those conversant with words, the lord of men, replied to the monarch, saying,

sa: सा हेमवर्णां नीलाङ्ग मैथिली राक्षसाधिपम्। शुशुभे काञ्चनी काञ्ची नीलं गजमिवाश्रिता ॥
en: And furnished with the hue of gold, Mithila's daughter beside the dark-bodied lord of the Rākşasas, looked like a golden girth round a sable elephant.

sa: यत्र तिष्ठाम्यहं तत्र मारुतो वाति शङ्कितः। तीव्रांशुः शिशिरांशुश्च भयात् सम्पद्यते दिवि॥
en: Wherever I live, the Wind bloweth cautiously and the Sun (of piercing rays) out of fear for me appeareth in the welkin like the Moon.

sa: निगृहीतस्त्वाय ब्रह्मन् विश्वामित्रो महाबलः। अमोघं ते बलं श्रेष्ठ लोकाः सन्तु गतव्यथाः॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, Viśvāmitra of mighty strength has been subdued by you. Infallible is your extraordinary mighty. Let the creatures now be relieved from their distress.'

sa: रवर्षता वज्रधरेण वापि। रामं तु गच्छन्तमित: समीक्ष्य जीवेन कश्चित्त्विति चेतना मे॥
en: Men may do without the Sun, and the wielder of the thunder-bolt not raining, but none, I apprehend, can live, on witnessing Rāma repairing hence.

sa: स पूर्वं बद्धवैरो मां राजा दृष्ट्वा व्यतिक्रमम्॥ घातयिष्यति दण्डेन तीक्ष्णेन कृतनिश्चयः।
en: Entertaining enmity against me of old, the king, seeing this lapse, must be firmly determined to take my life by means of a severe sentence.

sa: न व्यपत्रपसे नीच कर्मणानेन रावण। ज्ञात्वा विरहितां यो मां चोरयित्वा पलायसे॥
en: Do you not, O base wretch, O Ravana, feel shame on account of this act-you, who, knowing that I was alone fly away, carrying me?

sa: अनिष्टानि च पापानि पश्यामि विविधानि च। निमित्तान्यमनोज्ञानि तेन सीदति मे मनः॥
en: I witness various evil, unsightly, and unpleasant* omens, and hence my mind is depressed. *The commentator renders amongnani, inauspicious. I venture to differ from him.,

sa: स समृद्धां मया सार्धमयोध्यां गच्छ राघव। अभिषेचय चात्मानं कुलस्यास्य भवाय नः॥
en: Do you, therefore, O Rāghava go along with me to the prosperous Ayodhya; and get yourself ir stalled there for the behoof of our race.

sa: नित्यक्रोधतया तस्याः कथं नु खरवादिनम्। कैकेय्या वदनं द्रष्टुं पुत्र शक्ष्यामि दुर्गता॥
en: She is always of fretful temper, how shall I, reduced to misery (on account of your exile), eye the face of Kaikeyī, uttering harsh words.

sa: अयं सुरपते घोरो विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः। क्रोधमुत्स्रक्ष्यते घोरं मयि देव न संशयः॥
en: O lord of the celestials, this mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra, is a terrible person; and, without doubt, he will, O divine one, waxing wroth, curse me.

sa: अथैवमुक्त्वा वचनं सुदारुणं निधाय सर्वाभरणानि भामिनी। असंस्कृतामास्तरणेन मेदिनी तदाधिशिश्ये पतितेव किंनरी॥६५
en: Having said these cruel words, and thrown off every ornament, the wrathful dame lay down on the ground having no covering, like a fallen Kinnarī.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा स विनिष्क्रम्य ददृशे मुनिसत्तमः। महिषं पर्वताकारं गतासुं पतितं भुवि।।५१ ।
en: Saying this, that best of saints issued out (of the hermitage) and surveyed a lifeless buffalo lying on the earth, like to a huge mountain.

sa: स गृहीत्वा धनुर्गोरे शरमेकं च मानदः। सालमुद्दिश्य चिक्षेप पूरयन् स रवैर्दिशः॥
en: That one, conferring honours upon others, holding his terrible bow and a shaft, darted it towards the Sāla, filling all the quarters with a sound,

sa: न सा धर्षयितुं शक्या मैथिल्योजस्विनः प्रिया। दीप्तस्येव हुताशस्य शिखा सीता सुमध्यमा॥
en: And young Sītā beloved of the mighty Rāma, and like to the rays of flaming fire is ever incapable of being carried away by you.

sa: हीनो भ्रात्रा च पित्रा च शून्यामिक्ष्वाकुपालिताम्। अयोध्यां न प्रवेक्ष्यामि प्रवेक्ष्यामि तपोवनम्॥
en: Bereft of my brother and sire, I will not enter the empty Ayodhyā governed by the Ikşvākus. I will repair to the forest of asceticism.

sa: सर्वे परिगता देशा यज्ञियं न लभे पशुम्॥ दातुमर्हसि मूल्येन सुतमेकमितो मम।
en: I have ranged every country; but the beast I do not find. Therefore, it behove you to part with one of your sons for price.'

sa: प्रसीद पथ्यं शृणु जल्पितं हि मे न रोषमेवानुवधातुमर्हसि। क्षमो हि ते कोशलराजसूनुना न विग्रहः शक्रसमानतेजसा॥
en: It does not behove you to yield to the influence of ire your conflict with that son of the king of Kosala, gifted with the prowess of Sakra, will not conduce to your welfare.

sa: पूर्वमेतत् कृतं द्वारं पृथिव्या भुवनस्य च। सूर्यस्योदयनं चैव पूर्वा ह्येषा दिगुच्यते॥
en: As this is the first gateway of both Earth and Heaven, and as the sun first rises in this quarter, this is called the East.

sa: अथ रामोऽब्रवीत् सूतं शीघ्रं संयुज्यतां रथः। गमिष्यामि ततोऽरण्यं गच्छ शीघ्रमितः प्रभो॥
en: Rāma said to the charioteer, "Do you at once yoke the car. I will repair to the forest. Do you, my master, swiftly go hence."

sa: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च यशश्च जयतां वर। स्वामिप्रसादात् सचिवाः प्राप्नुवन्ति निशाचर॥
en: O you the best of conquerors, O you the ranger of high, ministers by the grace of their sovereign attain virtue, wealth, desires and fame.

sa: भवांस्तु सह वैदेह्या गिरिसानुषु रंस्यसे। अहं सर्वं करिष्यामि जाग्रतः स्वपतश्च ते॥
en: You shall amuse yourself with Vaidehī on the sides of the hill, and I shall perform everything for you whether you are asleep or awake.

sa: वीर्ये युद्धे च दर्प च न ह्यस्ति सदृशस्तव। उपायतो महाशूरो महामायाविशारदः॥
en: In prowess in battle, and in indomitableness, there is none like you. You are a mighty hero commanding resources, and conversant with potent illusory displays.

sa: अगत्वा निश्चयं राजा कालेन महता महान्। त्रिंशद्वर्षसहस्राणि राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः॥
en: And without being able to ascertain it, the mighty monarch after a long course of time, and having reigned for thirty thousand years, ascended heaven.

sa: शठो नैकृतिकः क्षुद्रो मिथ्याप्रश्रितमानसः। कथं दशरथेन त्वं जातः पापो महात्मना ॥
en: How are you, who are wicked, narrowminded, a liar and ever intent upon bringing about others' misfortune, born of the loins of the high-souled Dasaratha?

sa: दनिराकृता पूर्वं त्वया सौभाग्यवत्तया। राममाता सपत्नी ते कथं वैरं न यापयेत्॥
en: Your co-wife, Rāma's mother, had formerly through pride and good fortune been slighted by you. Why will not she upon you wreak her revenge now.

sa: तां तदा दर्शयित्वा तु मैथिली गिरिनिम्नगाम्। निषसाद गिरिप्रस्थे सीतां मांसेन छन्दयन्॥
en: Having showed to Mithila's daughter the river belonging to the mountain, Rāma sat down on its table-land and, gratifying Sita with meat, said to her.

sa: अयं रक्षतु मां रामः पर्वकाले समाहितः॥ मारीचान्मे भयं घोरं समुत्पन्नं नरेश्वर।
en: When I shall remain absorbed in meditation on the occasion of Parva, let Rāma protect me O king, Truly am I afraid of this Mārīca.

sa: तं शीघ्रमभिगच्छ त्वं यदि युद्धमिहेच्छसि। स हि दुर्मर्षणो नित्यं शूरः समरकर्मणि॥
en: Do you speedily repair to him if did you wish for a conflict. He is always expert in military exploits and is hard to repress.

sa: नास्ति शक्तिः पितुर्वाक्यं समतिक्रमितुं मम। प्रसादये त्वां शिरसा गन्तुमिच्छाम्यहं वनम् ॥
en: There is no power in me to transgress my father's behest's; bend low I my head to you, I want to proceed to the forest.

sa: तास्तु गत्वा परं तीरमवरोप्य च तं जनम्। निवृत्ता काण्डचित्राणि कियन्ते दासबन्धुभिः॥
en: And going to the other bank and landing the crowds on the shore, the friends and slaves (of Guha) while returning, movements (of the boats).

sa: दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य मध्ये तस्य तु राक्षसी। अङ्गारकेति विख्याता छायामाक्षिप्य भोजनी ॥
en: In the midst of the Southern sea belonging to him (Ravana), there is a Raksasi, named Angāraketi, who procureth her pray by casting her shadow.

sa: देवताभ्यो वरं प्राप्य समुत्थाप्य च वानरान्। अयोध्या प्रस्थितो रामः पुष्पकेण सुहृद्वृतः॥
en: Then Rāma, obtaining a boon from the celestials, revived the monkeys fallen in battle, and surrounded by friends, set out for Ayodhyā on the Puspaka.

sa: सषट् चाष्टौ च वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने। आसेवमानो वन्यानि फलमूलैश्च वर्तयन्॥
en: And I shall live in that solitary forest for eight and six years, feasting on roots, and fruits and performing the duties of a hermit.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा पुनः प्रोचुरालोक्य च परस्परम्॥ चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। एकश्च रामो धर्मात्मा कथं युद्धं भविष्यति॥
en: Having said this, they again spoke, eyeing one another, There are fourteen thousand of the Rākşasas of dreadful deed while the righteous Rāma is single. How can fight take place (between two such parties)?

sa: कृतकृत्या हि वैदेही छायेवानुगता पतिम्। न जहाति रता धर्मे मेरुमर्कप्रभा यथा॥
en: Vaidehī, attaining her desire, follows her husband, like a shadow, attached to virtue, she does not forsake him, even as the Sun forsakes not Meru.

sa: अयं तु सारथिस्तस्य मत्पक्षनिहतो भुवि। परिश्रान्तस्य मे पक्षौ छित्वा खङ्गेन रावणः॥ सीतामादाय वैदेहीमुत्पपात विहायसम्। रक्षसा निहतं पूर्वं मां न हन्तुं त्वमर्हसि ॥
en: This is his charioteer lying on earth being killed by the velocity of my wings. Having sundered my wings with his dagger, who had been exhausted, Rāvana taking Sītā, rose high up in the welkin. It behove you not to kill me who had been wounded before by the Rākşasa.

sa: तव शुश्रूषणं मूर्धा करिष्यामि वने वसन्। अयोध्यां देवलोकं वा सर्वथा प्रजहाम्यहम्॥
en: Living in the forest, I will serve you with the crown of my head; and I will entirely renounce Ayodhyā or the celestial regions themselves.

sa: किं हि कृत्वा विषण्णस्त्वं कुतो वा भयमस्ति ते। यत् परित्यक्तुकामस्त्वं मामनन्यपरायणाम्॥
en: Why are you so dejected and whence is your fear that you are willing to leave behind your wife who has none else but you?

sa: अयं वातात्मजः श्रीमान् प्लवते सागरोपरि। हनूमान् नाम तस्य त्वं मुहूर्तं विघ्नमाचर॥
en: The highly effulgent son of Wind named Hanumān is crossing over the main. You are required to throw obstacles in his way for a while.

sa: यज्ञियं च कृतं सर्वं पुरुषैः सुसमाहितैः। निर्यातु च भवान् यष्टुं यज्ञायतनमन्तिकात्॥
en: Everything has been carefully made ready for the sacrifice by the persons concerned. Do you, therefore, repair to the sacrificial ground, for performing the sacrifice.

sa: या हि सा दीप्यमानेव पाण्डवानभजत् पुरा। साद्य लक्ष्मीस्त्वया राजन्नवाप्ता भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: O king, the blazing goddess of prosperity, that once used to pay court to the Pandavas, has now been secured by you with your brothers.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो नित्यं दोषाः क्षमावताम्। अथ वैरोचने दोषानिमान् विद्वयक्षमावताम॥
en: These and various other evils attend always upon the forgiving. Listen, O son of Virochana, to (other) evils that beset a person that never forgives.

sa: ततो गच्छेत कावेरी वृतामप्सरसां गणैः। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then one should go to Kaveri, surrounded by the Apsaras. O king, bathing there a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: सर्वथा न हि मे पुत्राः सहामात्याः ससौबलाः। क्रुद्ध पार्थे च भीमे च वासुदेवे च सात्वते॥
en: When these Bhima, Partha (Arjuna) and Vasudeva (Krishna) of the Satvata race are angry, my sons with their friends and the son of Subala are surely not at all capable to fight with them.

sa: अद्यप्रभृति भद्रं वः प्रतिज्ञां मे निबोधत। त्रयोदश समास्तात को ममार्थोऽस्ति जीवतः॥
en: "O children, O blessed ones, listen to the vow I make from this day. For what other purpose am I to live for thirteen years?

sa: बहुधा दृश्यते धर्मः सूक्ष्म एव द्विजोत्तम। भवानपि च धर्मज्ञः स्वाध्यायनिरतः शुचिः॥
en: O foremost of the Brahmanas, virtue seems to be varied and fine. You, too, are holy, virtuous and devoted to the study of the Vedas.

sa: विषमस्थेन मूढेन परिभ्रष्टसुखेन च। यत् सा तेन परित्यक्ता तत्र न क्रोद्भुमर्हति॥
en: She should not be angry, forsaken as she was by a person, who himself was foolish, overtaken by distress and also destitute of all happiness.

sa: चिक्षेप तरसा भीमः समन्ताद् बलिनां वरः। विनदन् सुमहातेजा नृसिंह इव दर्पितः॥
en: That foremost of all strong men Bhima threw them on all sides; that greatly powerful hero, as proud as a lion, sent up loud shouts.

sa: नैतानि वेद यः कश्चिन्मुह्यन्तेऽत्र प्रजा इमाः। अपि कल्पसहस्रेण न स श्रेयोऽधिगच्छति॥
en: These are not known to all; ordinary people are ignorant of these; he does not follow in a thousand Kalpa the well-being of the celestials.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच हैहयानां कुलकरो राजा परपुरंजयः। कुमारो रूपसम्पन्नो मृगयां व्यचरद् बली॥
en: Markandeya said : Once upon a time a handsome and vigorous young prince of the Haihaya race, conqueror of enemies' cities, went out to hunt.

sa: ततस्तु तेषां पुनरेव हर्षः कैलासमालोक्य महान् बभूव। कुबेरकान्तं भरतर्षभाणां महीधरं वारिधरप्रकाशम्॥
en: But those best of the Bharatas again experienced a great delight on beholding the favourite mountain of Kubera, the Kailasa looking (white as the clouds).

sa: इदं सत्यं द्विजातीनां साधूनामात्मजस्य च। सुहृदां च जपेत् कर्णे शिष्यस्यानुगतस्य च॥
en: This truth (about Tirthas) should be recited to the ears of only Brahmanas, of the pious men, one's of own sons, friends, disciples and dependants.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु विप्रेण धमव्याधो युधिष्ठिर। प्रत्युवाच यथा विप्रं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप॥
en: Markandeya said : O Yudhishthira, O ruler of men, hear what the virtuous fowler said to that Brahmana when he was thus asked by him.

sa: सस्मार च पुरा वृत्तां कथां तां पुरुषर्षभ। अंशावतरणे यासौ ब्रह्मणो भवनेऽभवत्॥
en: O best of men, he recollected the words he had heard in the abode of Brahma; regarding the Angshavatarana, (incarnations of portions of every deity).

sa: मातर ऊचुः इच्छाम तासां मातृणां प्रजा भोक्तुं प्रयच्छ नः। त्वया सह पृथग्भूता ये च तासामथेश्वराः॥
en: The mothers said : We desire that while living with you we may be able to eat up the progeny of those mothers and their grandsons by assuming different shapes. Grant us this favour.

sa: आजग्मुः पाण्डवान् द्रष्टुं शुद्धात्मानो यतव्रताः। ते तैः सह कथां चक्रुर्दिव्यां भरतसत्तमाः॥
en: Of pure souls and observant of vows came there to see them. And those most exalted to the Bharatas talked with them on divine matters.

sa: ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वं सैन्यं मे गतचेतनम्। मां दृष्ट्वा रथनीडस्थं गतासुमिव भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, seeing me in a swoon on the car and one like dead, my soldiers all exclaimed, “Oh” and “Alas!”

sa: वेत्थ त्वं तात धर्माणां गतिं सूक्ष्मां युधिष्ठिर। विनीतोऽसि महाप्राज्ञ वृद्धानां पर्युपासिता॥
en: O child, O greatly wise Yudhisthira, you are full of humility, and you wait upon the old. You know the path of Dharma is subtle.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रभासतीर्थं सम्प्राप्य पुण्यं तीर्थं महोदधेः। वृष्णयः पाण्डवान् वीराः परिवार्योपतस्थिरे॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having arrived at the sacred Tirtha on the coast of sea, the heroic Vrishni surrounded the sons of Pandu and waited upon them.

sa: प्रातिष्ठत स दुष्टात्मा त्रीन् गृहीत्वा च पाण्डवान्। सहदेवस्तु यत्नेन ततोऽपक्रम्य पाण्डवः॥
en: And also having taken the Pandavas that wicked-minded wretch fled away. The Pandava Sahadeva extricated himself (from the grasp of the Rakshasa) with great efforts.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तो भरतश्रेष्ठ धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। कृत्वाऽऽर्यसमयं सर्वं प्रतस्थे भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed, and performing all the ceremonies of politeness, the best of the Bharata race, Dharmaraja Yudhisthira, started with his brothers.
